questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Look at the picture. [A black-and-white illustration shows a man and a woman standing on a sidewalk near a crosswalk in a city, with a bus approaching in the street, and a dog running alone across the crosswalk ahead of a bus.] What is the dog doing?
questions.explanation: 圖中的狗正走在斑馬線上，所以是在過馬路（crossing the street）。狗沒有咬人，也不是追著公車跑（公車在後方車道），更不是坐在人行道上。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Chris: Which _____ looks better on me?
Penny: I think purple's better. You look great in purple.
questions.explanation: Penny 回答「紫色比較好，你穿紫色很好看」，可知 Chris 問的是哪一個「顏色」比較適合他，選 color。grade 是年級／成績，shape 是形狀，size 是尺寸，都和「purple」對不上。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: My cat got excited when it saw the boy _____ the birds.
questions.concept_tag: 分詞構句與感官使役動詞
questions.explanation: 感官動詞 see 的句型是「see + 受詞 + 原形動詞／V-ing」，V-ing 表示看到動作正在進行。選項中只有 catching 符合，所以是 saw the boy catching the birds。catches、caught 是有時態的動詞，to catch 不能接在感官動詞後。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Mr. Jackson is a very _____ writer; people of all ages enjoy his stories.
questions.explanation: 後半句說「各年齡層的人都喜歡他的故事」，表示他是很受歡迎的作家，選 popular。polite（有禮貌的）、handsome（英俊的）、honest（誠實的）都和「大家都愛看他的故事」沒有因果關係。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Carol sounded happy when we talked on the phone; I could feel joy in her _____.
questions.explanation: 關鍵在 talked on the phone：講電話時看不到對方，只能從「聲音」感受到她的快樂，所以選 voice。eyes 和 smile 需要看得到，mail 是郵件，都不符合講電話的情境。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Mark studies very hard and never _____ classes. He goes to school even when he is sick.
questions.explanation: 後句說他生病也照樣上學，表示他從不「缺」課，miss classes 就是缺課、錯過課程。lose 是遺失、changes 是更換、forgets 是忘記，都不能和 classes 搭配表達「缺席」。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Have you got anything for Joe _____? He'd be happy to get your gift on his birthday.
questions.explanation: yet 用在疑問句句尾，表示「已經…了嗎」，Have you got anything for Joe yet? 意思是「你已經幫 Joe 準備禮物了嗎？」。almost（幾乎）、either（也不）、soon（很快）放在句尾都不通順。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Susan bought _____ bread in the supermarket, but she did not buy anything to drink.
questions.concept_tag: 數量詞與主詞動詞一致
questions.explanation: bread 是不可數名詞，不能用 many 或 one 修飾；肯定句中表示「一些」要用 some，any 通常用在否定句與疑問句。所以選 some bread。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Playing sports at least three times a week _____ good for your health.
questions.concept_tag: 數量詞與主詞動詞一致
questions.explanation: 主詞是動名詞片語 Playing sports at least three times a week，動名詞當主詞視為單數，所以動詞用 is。be good for 是「對…有益」，不能用 has／have。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: My parents have different hobbies. One enjoys baking; _____ enjoys taking pictures.
questions.explanation: 父母只有兩個人，兩者之中「一個…另一個…」用 one … the other …。another 用在三者以上的「另一個」，the next、the second 都不是這個固定用法。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: My mom told me to take care of _____ in England. She worried that I couldn't eat or sleep well there.
questions.explanation: take care of oneself 是「照顧自己」，主詞是被叮嚀的「我」，所以用反身代名詞 myself。後句說媽媽擔心我在英國吃不好、睡不好，也證明是要我照顧自己，不是照顧媽媽（her／herself）。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: The paint on the wall is not as _____ as it was ten years ago. It has changed from white to gray.
questions.explanation: 牆上的油漆從白色變成灰色，表示顏色沒有以前那麼「亮」了，not as bright as 就是「不如…明亮」。heavy（重的）、sure（確定的）、young（年輕的）都無法描述油漆顏色變暗。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: I told you this road went the wrong way, but you just wouldn't listen. Now we have to _____ and take another road.
questions.explanation: 這條路走錯方向了，要換另一條路，所以必須先「往回走」，turn back 是折返。go ahead（繼續往前）正好相反；move away（搬走）、pass by（經過）都不符合情境。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: The last five years have not been _____ to Jennie. Her face is covered with lines and she looks much older than she is.
questions.explanation: be kind to someone 原指「善待某人」，這裡說過去五年「沒有善待」Jennie，也就是這幾年過得很辛苦，所以她滿臉皺紋、看起來比實際年齡老很多。special、real、enough 都不能表達「歲月不饒人」的意思。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: My dog Jimmy loves _____ with a comb. Every time I comb his hair, he will close his eyes and fall asleep.
questions.explanation: 狗是「被人用梳子梳毛」，要用被動語態；love 後面接動名詞，被動形式是 being + 過去分詞，所以選 being brushed。to brush、brushing、to be brushing 都是主動，意思會變成狗自己在梳東西。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following notice:

Our Pinky Street, one of the oldest streets in the world, was almost lost to a big fire last night. Most of the old houses on Pinky were burned down. The living history we are proud of is dying. But we should never give up. Pinky is like a parent, always there caring for our town. Now we must do something together to get the old Pinky back. There will be a meeting at 2:00 this Saturday afternoon at Town Office. Anyone who wants to help is welcome. Let's see what we can do.

Adam Bolton, Town Office
March 9

What is the reading for?

options.A: Finding out why the old street was on fire.
options.B: Inviting people to do business on the old street.
options.C: Getting people to find ways to save the old street.
options.D: Asking for help for people who got hurt in the fire.

questions.explanation: 告示說老街被大火燒毀，但「我們絕不放棄」，要大家一起讓老 Pinky 回來，並邀請想幫忙的人週六來開會討論，目的是號召大家想辦法挽救老街，選 C。文中沒有追查起火原因（A），也沒提到做生意（B）或幫助傷者（D）。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following notice:

Our Pinky Street, one of the oldest streets in the world, was almost lost to a big fire last night. Most of the old houses on Pinky were burned down. The living history we are proud of is dying. But we should never give up. Pinky is like a parent, always there caring for our town. Now we must do something together to get the old Pinky back. There will be a meeting at 2:00 this Saturday afternoon at Town Office. Anyone who wants to help is welcome. Let's see what we can do.

Adam Bolton, Town Office
March 9

Which is NOT used in the reading to talk about the old street?
questions.explanation: 文中形容老街用了 the living history（活的歷史）、like a parent（像父母）、the old Pinky（老 Pinky），唯獨沒有出現 a good friend，所以選 A。這類 NOT 題要逐一回原文比對，找出沒出現的那個。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following ad:

FunGana 2016

No idea where to spend your vacation? If you are a big fan of sun, beach, and water sports, then you must join FunGana 2016!

Over the years, FunGana has taken people to many places in Gana. This year, we are taking you to Piso Island, one of Gana's beautiful islands. Piso Island is adjacent to Wako Island, the biggest island in Gana, so it is only 15 minutes away by boat from Wako Island. The best time to visit? All year around, the weather on Piso Island is just wonderful for a vacation. You can sail out to watch whales, or enjoy one of the best mud springs in the world. We will also show you around the island in a special car, the Cocoon Rider. It's our pleasure to help you enjoy your stay on Piso Island.

Find out more about FunGana 2016 at http://www.fungana2016.com.gn.

What is FunGana 2016 for?
questions.explanation: 這是一則旅遊廣告：FunGana 多年來帶人到 Gana 各地遊玩，今年帶大家去 Piso Island 賞鯨、泡泥漿溫泉、坐特別的車環島，目的就是讓人來體驗 Gana，選 D。賞鯨只是活動之一，不是研究海洋動物（A）；文中也沒有開水上運動課程（B）或提供氣象報告（C）。

questions.question_text:
Read the following ad:

What does the reading say about Piso Island?

options.A: It makes the best cars in Gana.
options.B: It has nice weather in every season.
options.C: It is the most popular island in Gana.
options.D: It has the most mud springs in the world.

questions.explanation: 文中說 All year around, the weather on Piso Island is just wonderful，一年到頭天氣都很好，等於「每個季節天氣都很好」，選 B。Cocoon Rider 只是帶你環島的車，不是島上製造的（A）；文中說它有世界上「最好的」泥漿溫泉之一，不是「最多」（D）；也沒說它最受歡迎（C）。

questions.question_text:

What does adjacent to mean?
questions.concept_tag: 上下文詞義與指代推測
questions.explanation: adjacent to 後面接著說「所以從 Wako Island 坐船只要 15 分鐘」，距離這麼短，可推知 adjacent to 是「鄰近、靠近」，選 Near。文中說 Wako 才是最大的島，所以不是 Bigger than；Like、Warmer than 都和「只要 15 分鐘」的結果無關。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Here is the schedule with the notice of the summer school that Tina goes to.

Schedule (課表):
Time | Mon. | Tues. | Wed. | Thurs. | Fri.
09:30~10:30 | English | Computer | English | English | Piano
10:40~11:40 | Piano | English | Painting | Dancing | Dancing
13:30~14:30 | Tennis | Painting | Tennis | Painting | Computer
14:40~15:40 | Baseball | Baseball | Swimming | Basketball | Basketball

NOTICE:
- The school restaurant is closed during the summer school (7/4~7/31). Please bring your own lunch. If you need to order lunch, please tell your class leader the day before.
- Dancing shoes can be borrowed with your summer school card. Please find Mr. Shum in Room 117.
- During the third week, the gym will be used for the High School Ball Games. Please go to the playground for the basketball classes of the week.

What do we know from the notice?

options.A: The summer school is three weeks long.
options.B: Students can order lunch from the school restaurant.
options.C: There are basketball classes in the gym every week except the third week.
options.D: Those who need to borrow dancing shoes must tell Mr. Shum the day before.

questions.explanation: 告示第三點說第三週體育館要辦比賽，那一週的籃球課改到操場上，可推知其他週的籃球課都在體育館上，選 C。暑期學校是 7/4～7/31，約四週，不是三週（A）；學校餐廳暑期關閉，訂餐要找班長（B 錯）；「前一天告知」是訂午餐的規定，借舞鞋只要帶暑期學校證去找 Mr. Shum（D 錯）。

questions.question_text:
Here is the schedule with the notice of the summer school that Tina goes to.

Schedule (課表):
Time | Mon. | Tues. | Wed. | Thurs. | Fri.
09:30~10:30 | English | Computer | English | English | Piano
10:40~11:40 | Piano | English | Painting | Dancing | Dancing

Below is what Tina told her friends about the classes in her summer school schedule.

"Mr. Reed was really crazy to give us so many new words at one time. Who can possibly remember all of them in a night? In our art class, when Ms. Grant asked us to draw a picture, I just drew a mad me looking at Mr. Reed. But then I totally forgot about Mr. Reed after two hours of PE classes in the afternoon. I was just too tired to think! Luckily, there was no computer class today to make it a really bad day."

Which day was Tina talking about?
questions.explanation: Tina 當天有英文課（背單字）、美術課（畫圖），下午上了兩小時的體育課，而且沒有電腦課。對照課表：星期三上午是 English、Painting，下午是 Tennis、Swimming 兩堂體育，也沒有 Computer，完全符合，選 C。星期一沒有美術課，星期二有電腦課，星期四下午是 Painting＋Basketball，只有一堂體育。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following poem:

The wind keeps blowing.
The door keeps opening.
Will you be with me, my dear Lucy,
When I look for candy
Down there in the dark, dark kitchen?

The wind keeps crying.
The door keeps shaking.
Will you be with me, my dear Lucy,
When I pick up my toy puppy
Out there on the high, high balcony?

Wish you could always be with me
And make them go away with your Do-Re-Me.
I remember last Halloween
They ran away when you started to sing,
"Dear Tommy, my little king,
Close your eyes and have a sweet dream."

So please stay with me and sing
To stop them kicking the door, riding the wind,
And pulling me down to their house under the ground.
They'll go away if you sing here for me,
In a voice that gets a black cat's hair standing,
The strongest legs shaking, and the window glass breaking.

(ideas from Matthew Sweeney's poem)

Which is most likely true about the speaker in the reading?

options.A: He thinks a black cat is hiding somewhere in the house.
options.B: He feels lonely because he is the only child in his family.
options.C: He is looking for something he left somewhere in the house.
options.D: He is afraid of being by himself when he feels ghosts around.

questions.explanation: 詩中的孩子在風聲、門響中不敢一個人去黑暗的廚房、高高的陽台，還提到 they 會踢門、乘風而來、想把他拉到「地底下的家」，去年萬聖節是 Lucy 唱歌才把 they 趕走，可見他感覺到有鬼在身邊而害怕獨處，選 D。黑貓只是形容 Lucy 歌聲的比喻（A）；文中沒提到他是獨生子（B）；他去廚房拿糖果、去陽台拿玩具，不是在找遺失的東西（C）。

questions.question_text:
Read the following poem:

What can we learn about Lucy in the reading?

options.B: Her voice makes the speaker feel safe.
options.C: Her candy was hidden in the kitchen.
options.D: She was away from home last Halloween.

questions.explanation: 說話者希望 Lucy 一直陪著他，因為只要 Lucy 唱歌，they 就會離開，去年萬聖節也是她一唱歌 they 就跑了，可見 Lucy 的歌聲讓他感到安心，選 B。一直開著的門是被風吹的，不是 Lucy 開的（A）；找糖果的是說話者（C）；去年萬聖節 Lucy 正在唱歌給他聽，並沒有不在家（D）。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following comic strip about the book Catch-22:

Panel 1: A book cover, "Catch-22, by Joseph Heller."
Panel 2: An open book showing the words "There was a soldier..."
Panel 3: A small plane flying, being shot at, with explosions and another plane crashing nearby.
Panel 4: The soldier, standing by his plane, thinks: "This job is dangerous. I could die any time I fly."
Panel 5: The soldier stands outside a building labeled "Hospital."
Panel 6: Soldier to Doctor: "Doctor, how can I get out of my dangerous job?"
Panel 7: Narration: "Rule 22 – A soldier can stop flying airplanes only if he is crazy. But he has to MAKE THE DOCTOR BELIEVE IT."
Panel 8: Soldier (smiling): "That's easy!"
Panel 9: Doctor explains: "Really? Think about it. If you are crazy, you won't worry about your life. Then you would never think you should stop flying airplanes. If you ever think you should stop flying, it means that you worry about your life and that you're not crazy. If you are not crazy, you have to keep flying. You see, you're caught by Rule 22. You have no way out. You will still need to fly."
Panel 10: Narration: "Now people use 'catch-22,' the name of Joseph Heller's book, to mean that someone has a problem like the soldier's." A diagram shows a cycle: "want to stop" → "get crazy first" → BUT → "already got crazy" → "will not want to stop" (back to start), showing the soldier trapped in a loop with no way out.

What does IT in picture 7 mean?

options.B: Anyone can die at any time.

questions.concept_tag: 上下文詞義與指代推測
questions.explanation: Rule 22 說士兵「只有瘋了」才能不再開飛機，但他必須讓醫生相信 IT，IT 指的就是前面的條件「士兵已經瘋了」，選 D。後面醫生的解釋也都在討論他到底瘋了沒有。

What can we learn from the comics?

options.B: The soldier cared about his life more than his job.

questions.explanation: 士兵覺得開飛機隨時可能喪命，所以跑去問醫生怎麼擺脫這份工作，可見他在乎自己的命勝過這份工作，選 B。醫生只是解釋 Rule 22，沒有想各種辦法幫他（A）；士兵問的是怎麼離開危險工作，Rule 22 是醫生告訴他的（C）；第 10 格說人們是「現在」才用書名 catch-22 來形容這種困境，所以不是出現在書之前（D）。

From the comics, which is most likely an example of "catch-22"?

options.A: I need to go to hospital, but there are no hospitals near my house.
options.B: I need my key to open the door of my house, but I left my key at school.
options.C: I need some special experience to get this job, but I can't get this kind of experience except from this job.
options.D: I want to go out with Jennifer on New Year's Day, but I'm not sure whether she wants to go out with me that day.

questions.explanation: catch-22 指「想達成 A 必須先有 B，但要有 B 又必須先有 A」的死循環，就像士兵想停飛得先瘋，但會想停飛就代表沒瘋。C 選項「要有經驗才能得到這份工作，但這種經驗只能從這份工作取得」正是這種無解循環。A、B、D 只是一般的困難或不確定，並沒有互相卡死。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following dialogue:

Alec: So, what do you think about it?
Ellie: It's...interesting.
Alec: Oh, no, don't say that.
Ellie: The first thing you should know about Olivia is that she's scared of anything with six legs. I don't think she'll be able to walk past the gate of Buzzing World.
Alec: But she loves butterflies! Well, she loved the photos of butterflies I took last time I was there.
Ellie: Only when they're not moving.
Alec: Fine. I'll just take her somewhere else, and that'd be OK. Right?
Ellie: Umm, you're taking her to Wavelength for dinner?
Alec: What's wrong with that?!
Ellie: I wouldn't say a dead fish is really her idea of a nice dinner, and this restaurant sells seafood...
Alec: Now you're wrong about this one. She loved my mom's fish balls. She had several last time!
Ellie: OK, let's ask someone else. Oh, there's Lori. Hey, Lori, could you look at Alec's plan? He's taking Olivia out.
Lori: Wow! Everything's written down on paper! Hmmm... I thought you wanted her to be your girlfriend.
Alec: I do!
Lori: If you follow this plan, I'm sure it'll be your only date with her.

What does it in the first line mean?
questions.concept_tag: 上下文詞義與指代推測
questions.explanation: Alec 開頭問「你覺得 it 怎麼樣？」，接著 Ellie 評論 Olivia 會怕 Buzzing World 的昆蟲、不愛去海鮮餐廳吃飯，後來 Ellie 又請 Lori 看看 Alec's plan，可知 it 就是 Alec 的約會計畫，選 C。大門、蝴蝶照片、六隻腳的東西都是後面才提到的細節。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following news report:

Since the first case of "Cow Cold" was reported in Kirk State in June, this killer cold has moved up north faster than we thought it would. By July, almost every part of the country had been attacked by Cow Cold. In only two months, the number of dead cows has risen to 5,000. Though Cow Cold started in the south, the east of the country is the worst hit area. By this week, 80% of the farms in Osten State have reported cases of Cow Cold.

The sale of milk in Osten State has slumped because of Cow Cold. Before Cow Cold, the sale of milk in Osten State was $2.5 million each week; now it is less than $500,000.

Odin State is the only area in the north without cases of Cow Cold. Before we know how to deal with Cow Cold, we can only hope Odin State will be lucky enough not to experience the power of this killer cold.

(Elaine Baker, City Post)

What can we learn from the news report?

options.A: How to deal with Cow Cold.
options.B: Whether people may catch Cow Cold.
options.C: How fast Cow Cold has hit the country.
options.D: How to find out if cows have Cow Cold.

questions.explanation: 報導說 Cow Cold 六月從南方的 Kirk State 出現，往北擴散得比預期快，到七月幾乎全國都被波及，兩個月內死了 5,000 頭牛，重點在它擴散得多快，選 C。文末說「在我們知道怎麼對付它之前」，可見還沒有對策（A）；文中也沒提到人會不會感染（B）或如何檢查牛有沒有得病（D）。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following news report:

Since the first case of "Cow Cold" was reported in Kirk State in June, this killer cold has moved up north faster than we thought it would. By July, almost every part of the country had been attacked by Cow Cold. In only two months, the number of dead cows has risen to 5,000. Though Cow Cold started in the south, the east of the country is the worst hit area. By this week, 80% of the farms in Osten State have reported cases of Cow Cold.

Odin State is the only area in the north without cases of Cow Cold. Before we know how to deal with Cow Cold, we can only hope Odin State will be lucky enough not to experience the power of this killer cold.

(Elaine Baker, City Post)

Which map will most likely appear with the above news report? Each option shows a compass-oriented map of the country divided into regions, with a legend: filled circle = more than 1000 dead, cross-hatched circle = more than 500 dead, wave-pattern circle = more than 100 dead, dashed circle = more than 50 dead. The four maps differ in how many regions in the east are marked with the "more than 1000 dead" symbol and in whether the north has any marked regions.

options.A: (圖) Map showing multiple large "more than 1000 dead" circles clustered in the eastern regions, with the northernmost region unmarked.
options.B: (圖) Map showing even more "more than 1000 dead" circles across most regions including some in the north.
options.C: (圖) Map similar to (A) but with a slightly different arrangement of "more than 1000 dead" circles in the east, north region unmarked.
options.D: (圖) Map showing only two "more than 1000 dead" circles in the south, with no markings in the east or north.

questions.explanation: 報導有兩個關鍵：東部是災情最嚴重的地區，而且北部只有 Odin State 一個地區沒有病例。(A) 圖東側連續三個「超過 1000 頭」的大黑圈，最北邊的一區完全沒有標記，兩點都符合。(B) 東部雖然一樣嚴重，但最北邊那區也有病例標記，違反「北部 Odin State 沒有病例」；(C)、(D) 的大黑圈集中在南部，不符合「東部最嚴重」。
questions.text_issue: 選項 B、C 的文字描述與原圖不符：原圖 B 的東部重災區與 A 相同，差別在最北邊那區也畫了「超過 50 頭」的標記（非「更多大黑圈遍布各區」）；原圖 C 的兩個「超過 1000 頭」大黑圈在南部（非「與 A 類似、集中在東部」）。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: If a store's sales keep slumping, what would the sales chart look like? Each option is a line chart titled "Sales" with the y-axis in dollars ($0 to $100,000) and the x-axis showing the months Aug., Sept., Oct., Nov.

options.A: (圖) Line chart starting near $90,000 in August and steadily decreasing each month down to below $25,000 by November.
options.B: (圖) Line chart starting near $10,000 in August and steadily increasing each month up to about $90,000 by November.
options.C: (圖) Line chart zig-zagging: about $25,000 in August, up to $75,000 in September, down to $25,000 in October, up to $75,000 in November.
options.D: (圖) Line chart staying roughly flat around $70,000-$75,000 from August through November.

questions.explanation: slump 的意思從上文可推知：Osten State 的牛奶銷售額從每週 250 萬美元跌到不到 50 萬，所以 slump 是「暴跌、大幅下滑」。銷售額持續 slumping，圖表就應該一路往下，選 A（從約 9 萬一路降到 1 萬左右）。B 是一路上升，C 是忽高忽低，D 則幾乎持平。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following passage:

It was 11 p.m. and Molly walked out of her bakery. She turned and looked at her store one last time. She wanted to remember what it __35__ at the moment. A few hours later, people would come and clean out everything in the store. A young man had bought it. He __36__ it into a flower shop.

Before it was a bakery, this place __37__ a small coffee shop. Molly worked in the shop as a waitress. But taking orders was never Molly's dream; baking was. When she knew her boss planned to sell the shop, she borrowed money and bought it.

Her bakery had been open for thirty years. Thirty very wonderful years. However, it would all come to an end tonight. Molly __38__ the bakery to be a family business. But her daughter was never interested in baking. Molly did not want her business in a stranger's hands, so after some serious thinking, she decided to close it.

"Goodbye, my dear old friend," Molly looked at the store, whispering.

Choose the best word(s) for blank 35.
questions.explanation: 這段是用過去式敘述「當時」的情景：It was 11 p.m.，她想記住店在那一刻（at the moment）的樣子，動作和敘述時間同時，用簡單過去式 looked like，選 B。had looked like 表示更早之前，would look like 表示之後，has looked like 是現在完成式，都和過去的當下不合。

Read the following passage:

questions.explanation: Molly「一直以來」都希望麵包店能成為家族事業，這個心願發生在「今晚關店」這個過去時間點之前，要用過去完成式 had wanted，選 A。後文說女兒對烘焙沒興趣、她最後決定關店，可見這個願望已經落空；has wanted 是現在完成式，would／will want 表示未來，都不對。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following passage:

What does the word family mean to you? An American study in 2006 showed that people today __39__. Over 99% of the people who were interviewed agree that a husband, a wife, and a child are a family. At the same time, 94% see a parent with a child as a family, 91% say a husband and a wife, without children, are a family, and 81% think a man and a woman, with a child, but not married, are a family too.

The study also found that __40__ is very important in the modern thinking on family. Though 81% think a man and a woman, not married, with a child, are a family, the percentage (%) drops to 40% if the couple doesn't have a child. This is also true with same-sex couples. About 60% see two men, or two women, with a child, as a family, but only 32% think so when the couple doesn't have a child.

In the study, those who see two men or two women that live together as a family often find it OK for same-sex couples to get married. __41__. However, not everyone opens their arms to same-sex couples: the study said 30% have no problem seeing pets as part of one's family, but they do not think a same-sex couple is a family.

Choose the best answer for blank 39.

options.A: think differently about when to start a family
options.B: do not find family as important as their parents did
options.C: want many different things when they start a family
options.D: have several different ideas about what makes a family

questions.explanation: 空格後面列出一連串數據：夫妻加孩子、單親加孩子、沒孩子的夫妻、未婚伴侶加孩子，各有不同比例的人認為這「算一個家庭」，說明現代人對「什麼構成家庭」有好幾種不同看法，選 D。文章討論的不是何時成家（A）、家庭重不重要（B）或成家時想要什麼（C）。

questions.explanation: 前一句說：會把同住的兩男或兩女視為家庭的人，通常也認為同性伴侶可以結婚，這是很合理、可以預期的結果，所以接「這並不令人意外」，選 A。下一句用 However 轉折，說「不過並不是每個人都接受同性伴侶」，正好和 A 形成對比；B、C、D 都是負面語氣，接在 However 前面語意會不通。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Look at the picture. The dog is sitting _____. [Picture: A woman is driving a convertible car. A dog is sitting in the driver's seat area next to her, and a handbag is on the seat by the car door.]

options.D: between the woman and the bag

questions.explanation: 看圖：狗坐在車子左邊，開車的女子坐中間，包包放在她右邊，所以狗是坐在女子旁邊，next to the woman（在…旁邊）正確。狗並沒有坐在包包上或包包裡；(D) between the woman and the bag 是「在女子和包包之間」，但站在中間的是女子而不是狗。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: My sister wants to buy a car _____ she doesn't have enough money.
questions.explanation: 前半句「想買車」、後半句「錢不夠」，兩句意思相反，要用表示轉折的 but（但是）。because 表原因、if 表條件、or 表選擇，都接不起這兩句。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Jim always forgets my birthday. He has asked me many times and still can't _____ it.
questions.explanation: 第一句說 Jim 總是忘記(forgets)我的生日，接著說他問過我很多次卻還是「記不住」，所以選 remember（記得）。answer（回答）、celebrate（慶祝）、understand（了解）都不符合「忘記」這個語意線索。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: The little girl was _____ by a truck on her way home and was badly hurt.
questions.explanation: 小女孩「被卡車 ___ 」而且傷得很重(badly hurt)，合理的是 was hit by a truck（被卡車撞）。hit 的過去分詞仍是 hit；led（被帶領）、lost（遺失）、paid（被付錢）都和受傷無關。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Excuse me. I really need to go now. My kids _____ for me at school.
questions.explanation: 說話者「現在」急著要走，因為孩子「此刻正在」學校等他，要用現在進行式 are waiting。were waiting 和 waited 是過去的事，無法說明現在要離開的理由；wait 是現在簡單式，表習慣而非此刻正在發生。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Amy's father is very sick. The doctors can do nothing for him, so Amy went to the temple to _____ for him.
questions.explanation: 醫生已經無能為力，Amy 去廟裡為父親「祈禱」，pray for sb. 是「為某人祈禱」。care for 是照顧、look for 是尋找、count 是數數，都不符合去寺廟的情境。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: I'm glad that my school has students wear _____. I don't have to worry about what clothes to wear to school.
questions.explanation: 後一句說「不用煩惱要穿什麼衣服去上學」，可知學校要學生穿「制服」uniforms。belts（皮帶）、caps（帽子）、gloves（手套）都只是配件，無法解決穿什麼衣服的問題。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: We are surprised that Sally and Ray decided to get married. No one knows _____. They often fight with each other and are unhappy together.
questions.explanation: 兩人常吵架、在一起不快樂，卻決定結婚，所以大家不知道的是他們結婚的「原因」，用 why。where（地點）、when（時間）、how（方式）都和後文「吵架、不快樂」的線索無關。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: I don't think Katie will read any one of the books you've picked out for her: _____ look(s) very boring.
questions.explanation: 空格指的是前面「你挑給她的那些書」(the books)，是複數，所以代名詞用 they。it 只能指單數的一本書；one 或 some 只指其中幾本，但前句是說她一本都不會讀，表示所有書看起來都很無聊。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Jenny's bag is very heavy because _____ filled with toy cars.
questions.concept_tag: 數量詞與主詞動詞一致
questions.explanation: 包包很重，是因為「它(包包)裝滿了玩具車」，主詞要指回 Jenny's bag（單數），所以用 it is (filled with...)。they are 是複數，對不上 bag；there is/there are 表示「有…」，後面不能再接 filled with 來說明包包的狀態。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: _____ a map with you when you go to a place for the first time.
questions.explanation: 這句沒有主詞，是對人提出建議的祈使句，要用原形動詞開頭：Take a map with you（要帶地圖）。Have taken、Taking、To take 都不能單獨當祈使句的動詞。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: The weather _____ rainy and cloudy in the last few days. I hope the sun will come out soon.
questions.explanation: in the last few days（過去這幾天）表示從過去一直持續到現在，要用現在完成式 has been。後句「希望太陽快點出來」也說明現在仍在下雨；had been 是過去完成式，will be/would be 則是未來或假設，都不對。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: All the excuses Nick made _____ a lot about how much he hates to do the job.
questions.explanation: Nick made 是省略關係代名詞的形容詞子句，用來修飾主詞 All the excuses，整句還缺主要動詞，所以填 say（主詞複數，用原形）。saying 和 to say 不能當主要動詞；which say 會變成另一個子句，句子仍然沒有主要動詞。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Sabine walks so _____ in the apartment that sometimes you don't even know she's just passed by. You wonder if her feet ever touch the floor.
questions.explanation: 她走過你都沒察覺，讓人懷疑她的腳有沒有碰到地板，表示她走路「很輕」，選 lightly。freely（自由地）、shyly（害羞地）、slowly（慢慢地）都無法解釋「腳像沒碰到地板」；走得慢不一定讓人察覺不到。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: In the past, people thought it was a _____ idea to send e-mails and read news online, but now it is part of our everyday life.
questions.explanation: 句中用 but 對比：以前覺得寄電子郵件、上網看新聞是「新奇」的點子，現在已是日常生活的一部分，所以選 fresh（新鮮的、新穎的）。simple、popular、good 都無法和「現在已成日常」形成對比。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following notice.

The book festival is coming!
Do you have some books you don't want? Your old love may be someone's new favorite.
Bring one book to the Town Library & get another one home for free!

When & How:
March 2 - March 14: Bring one book for one book festival card.
March 16 - March 31: Bring one card for one book you like to read.

What books: All kinds of books EXCEPT school books, comic books, and dictionaries.

Notice:
1. Your book must be in good shape, without any page missing.
2. Your book must be clean, and nothing is written on it.

Want to know more? Please call 1234-5678. (We are closed on Mondays.)
-Town Library-

Question: What is the book festival for?

options.B: Telling people how to choose books.
options.C: Inviting people to change books with each other.
options.D: Knowing what kinds of books are the most popular.

questions.explanation: 海報說「帶一本書來圖書館，就能免費帶另一本回家」，還說「你的舊愛可能是別人的新歡」，目的是讓大家用書交換書，選 (C)。整個活動不收錢，所以不是賣二手書 (A)；也沒有教人挑書或調查哪類書最受歡迎。

options.B: A book of short stories in English.
options.C: A picture book with her own notes.
options.D: A workbook she used in her math class.

questions.explanation: What books 寫明不收 school books（課本）、comic books（漫畫）和 dictionaries（字典），Notice 還規定書上不能有字跡。(A) 是字典、(C) 有她自己寫的筆記、(D) 是數學課用過的作業本（屬學校用書），都不符規定；只有 (B) 英文短篇故事書可以拿去。

[Calendar of March: Sun-Sat columns. Week 1: 1(Mon) 2(Tue) 3(Wed) 4(Thu) 5(Fri) 6(Sat). Week 2: 7(Sun) 8(Mon) 9(Tue) 10(Wed) 11(Thu) 12(Fri) 13(Sat). Week 3: 14(Sun) 15(Mon) 16(Tue) 17(Wed) 18(Thu) 19(Fri) 20(Sat). Week 4: 21(Sun) 22(Mon) 23(Tue) 24(Wed) 25(Thu) 26(Fri) 27(Sat). Week 5: 28(Sun) 29(Mon) 30(Tue) 31(Wed).]
questions.explanation: 書展卡要在 March 16～March 31 才能用來換書，且圖書館星期一休館。(A) 3 日、(B) 14 日都還在「拿書換卡」的階段；看月曆，(D) 29 日是星期一休館；(C) 23 日是星期二，可以用卡換書。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following passage.

I had a horrendous experience last Saturday.
That day, my family went camping near a big lake. While my parents were preparing dinner, my brother and I were playing by the lake. A dirty man appeared from somewhere, and his face was half covered by his hair. He walked to us and asked for some water.
When I gave him water, the bag he carried dropped, and things inside fell out on the grass. I saw a rope, a knife, and a baseball bat. The strangest thing was that there were also a woman's shoe and a ring, and I'm sure they were not his. The man quickly put all his things back in the bag and looked at us angrily. At that moment, the picture of a man the police was looking for came to my mind. He was the crazy killer! I was so afraid that I could not move at all.
Luckily, before he could get any closer, my mom shouted from far away, and the man hurried off into the dark.

Question: What happened in the story?

options.A: A killer was caught by the police.
options.B: The writer's family invited a stranger to dinner.
options.C: The writer's brother ran to their parents for help.
options.D: A man ran away after he heard the writer's mother's voice.

questions.explanation: 文章最後說媽媽從遠處大喊，那個男人就匆忙跑進黑暗裡，所以 (D) 正確。文中沒有提到警察抓到兇手 (A)，只是作者想起警方在找的通緝照片；也沒有邀陌生人吃晚餐，或弟弟跑去找父母求救。

Question: What can we learn about the writer and the man with a bag?

options.B: The writer followed the man into the dark.
options.C: The writer did not find out who the man was in the end.
options.D: The man did not want the writer to see things in his bag.

questions.explanation: 袋子裡的繩子、刀、女鞋等東西掉出來後，男子「很快把東西收回袋子，還生氣地瞪著我們」，可見他不想讓作者看到袋中物品，選 (D)。媽媽在男子靠近前就大喊，他並沒有攻擊作者 (A)；作者其實認出了他是通緝中的瘋狂殺人犯，所以 (C) 也錯。

questions.question_text:
Read the following passage.

That day, my family went camping near a big lake. While my parents were preparing dinner, my brother and I were playing by the lake. A dirty man appeared from somewhere, and his face was half covered by his hair. He walked to us and asked for some water.

Question: How do people feel when they experience something horrendous?
questions.explanation: horrendous 用來形容作者那天的經歷，文中說他遇到疑似殺人犯時「怕到完全動不了」(so afraid that I could not move)，可推知 horrendous 是「可怕的」，經歷這種事會覺得害怕 Scared。文中沒有表現生氣、難過或疲累的情緒。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following dialogue.

Ruth: I've got two tickets for a football game. The Lions vs. the Sharks, front-row seats, next Saturday. Interested? You can take Jessica to the game.
Nate: How did you get the tickets?! They were all sold out months ago!
Ruth: And a table for two at Leeds.
Nate: Leeds?! But I called them yesterday and they said they were all booked for the year!
Ruth: Now it's yours. You and Jessica can have a lovely dinner there after the game.
Nate: Wait a second. This is just not like you. What's the catch?
Ruth: Well, you know this Friday I'm leaving for my vacation in London, and . . . .
Nate: And what?
Ruth: And I was thinking if Charlie could stay with you next week.
Nate: The whole week?!
Ruth: Please! I can't just leave him in my apartment.
Nate: You know I hate that stupid dog! And he hates me too.
Ruth: Please! You're my last hope.
Nate: I need to think about it.
Ruth: OK, but not too long.

Question: What does the catch mean in the dialogue?

options.A: A plan that starts well but ends badly.
options.B: A fact that everyone knows but never talks about.
options.C: A problem that is hidden behind something good.
options.D: An action that is right in one way but wrong in another.

questions.concept_tag: 上下文詞義與指代推測
questions.explanation: Ruth 突然送 Nate 買不到的球賽門票和訂不到的餐廳位子，Nate 覺得不像她的作風，問 What's the catch?，接著 Ruth 才說出真正目的：要他照顧她的狗一整週。可見 the catch 指「藏在好處背後的麻煩條件」，選 (C)。

questions.explanation: Ruth 請求讓 Charlie（她的狗）在她去倫敦時住到 Nate 家，Nate 抱怨討厭那隻狗後說 I need to think about it，這裡的 it 就是指「照顧 Charlie」這件事，選 (A)。晚餐、球賽都是 Ruth 送的好處，去倫敦度假是 Ruth 自己的行程，都不是 Nate 需要考慮的事。

Question: What do we know from the dialogue?

options.C: Nate is the first person that Ruth thought of for help.

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following passage.

When you need to see a doctor, surely you will want to see a good one. But there is one important thing you may never have thought about: Has your doctor rested enough?
Doctors in our country often have to work 34 hours or longer without sleep. Most of them work 104 hours a week, and some even 150. (There are only 168 hours a week!) One report said that a doctor who works such long hours cannot think more clearly than a drunk driver. Another found that doctors who sleep 5.8 fewer hours than the week before might make 22% more serious mistakes. Surely no one wants to get in a car that is driven by a drunk driver. So, how safe would you feel when you are under the care of a tired doctor?
Sadly this problem has been around for a long time. There are no laws about it yet and hospital bosses don't look like they care either. And that is why we doctors are asking you to join us on the street this Sunday. Fight together with us on the street so we can fight better for your life in the hospital.
Time: 1 p.m. May 2nd  Place: City Hospital Square

Question: What is this reading for?

options.A: Telling people rules about hospital visits.
options.B: Getting people to stand up and speak for doctors.
options.C: Telling people how to find a good doctor for themselves.
options.D: Getting doctors to share their experiences in saving lives.

questions.explanation: 文章先說醫生工時過長、疲勞會增加醫療錯誤，最後寫「請你這個星期天和我們一起上街」，並附上時間地點，目的是號召民眾站出來替醫生發聲，選 (B)。文中沒有講就醫規則 (A) 或怎麼找好醫生 (C)，也不是請醫生分享救人經驗 (D)。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following advertisement.

Have you ever seen a pumpkin that looks like a nose or an apple that looks like a funny face? They may not look great, but they taste just as good as the pretty ones. These strange-looking fruit and vegetables are called "seconds." About 20-40% of what farmers grow is not so beautiful. Sadly, these "seconds" seldom arrive at your table, but often go straight into the trash can. Why? It's because supermarkets don't want to buy them from farmers—they believe their shoppers only love beautiful things. Because of these "seconds," some farmers lose a lot of money.
Wonky Markt wishes to change this. We're helping sell these "seconds." Farmers can save them from the trash can, and you can get them at a lower price.

[Box graphic labeled "Wonky Markt" with pictures of a carrot, apple, and pear/vegetable faces.]
1. NT$250 a box.
2. You can choose as many as six kinds of fruit and vegetables a box.
3. Service charge: NT$50 a box.
4. No service charge if order is over NT$1,000.

Send us photos of your delicious dishes that are made with our "seconds" to oneandonly@wonkymarkt.com, and you may win our cookbook.

Question: What does Wonky Markt care about?

options.A: Supermarkets often sell "seconds" at a lower price.
options.B: Farmers don't know how to grow fewer "seconds."
options.C: "Seconds" are thrown away because of how they look.
options.D: People don't know much about picking fresh "seconds."

questions.explanation: 文中說長得醜的蔬果（seconds）因為超市認為顧客只喜歡好看的東西而不收購，常被直接丟進垃圾桶；Wonky Markt 就是想改變這件事，所以它在意的是 seconds 因外表而被丟掉，選 (C)。超市其實根本不賣 seconds (A)，文中也沒說農夫不知道怎麼少種 (B)。

Read the following news about Dashing Shuttle's bus line changes.

[Map showing Dashing Shuttle bus lines radiating from Apple City to: Peach City, Bean Town, Lemon City, Orange Island, Melon City, Banana Town, Papaya City, Guava Town, Grape Town, Berry City, and Mango Island. 1. Great news for people who travel between Apple City and Peach City! From July 1, we have three more buses to Peach City every day.

Question: What can we learn from the reading?

options.A: No buses go from Apple City to Orange Island before the bus line changes.
options.B: Before July 1, those who want to visit Mango Island have to take a bus at Berry City.
options.C: Traveling from Apple City to Grape Town will take less time after the bus line changes.

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following report from Cinema Times, June 5th, 2005.

Thanks to globalization, we get to see movies from around the world. If anyone should feel most excited about globalization, it is US movie makers. A study in 2001 shows that, for every 100 people who go to the theater, 85 see US movies. This may be good news for US movie makers, but not for those in other countries.
Chart 1 shows the percentages (%) of US movies in five countries in 1984 and in 2001; Chart 2 shows the percentages (%) of domestic movies in the five countries in 1984 and in 2001. In Chart 1, we can see that US movies have been popular in foreign markets. In Chart 2, we can see that domestic movies in the five countries are not doing well in their domestic market. The falling market for domestic movies may be a serious problem, but there is something more important. When people welcome US movies with open arms, they in fact also say yes to the American way of thinking. Some people in these countries worry that what is lost may not just be their domestic market for domestic movies, but also their own way of thinking that has been passed down from parents to children.

Chart 1 (% of US movies in 1984 / % of US movies in 2001): France 39/47, Italy 48/60, Spain 53/62, UK 81/74, Germany 66/77.
Chart 2 (% of domestic movies in 1984 / % of domestic movies in 2001): France 45/42, Italy 34/19, Spain 22/18, UK 17/5, Germany 17/16.

Question: What does the report say about globalization's influence on the movie world?

options.A: It has changed the way of making movies.
options.B: It has changed a country's domestic market for movies.
options.C: It has brought together movie makers from around the world.
options.D: It has helped US movies make more money abroad than in the US.

questions.explanation: 報導說全球化後美國電影在各國市場越來越受歡迎，而各國本國電影在自己國內「表現不佳」(not doing well in their domestic market)，也就是全球化改變了各國國內的電影市場，選 (B)。文中沒談拍片方式 (A) 或各國電影人合作 (C)，也沒有比較美國電影在國外和國內賺多少錢 (D)。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following passage and choose the best answer for each blank.

Jerry Stevens has been unhappy these months. He __34__ a proud businessman of a successful shaved ice shop. His highest sales numbers were 1,899 plates a week; people called him "Ice King." But all this changed when the cookie shop across the street started selling ice cream cookies. It took away half of his business.
And __35__ when Dan, his dead sister's only son, came to work for him.
Dan was a nice young man with a simple mind, too simple, maybe. He always let people try some shaved ice for free, but he never learned to see when "some" became "too much." Many people came, but few bought. When the sales did not grow with the heat, Jerry started to worry. He wanted to send Dan home. But how could he? Dan had no family except him.
Then, one day, __36__. And it was from across the street. The cookie shop __37__ a clerk. For Jerry, it was a great chance to get Dan out of his store without sending him home. After taking the shopkeeper to several nice dinners, Jerry got Dan the job.
Now Jerry could finally try and save his store. And maybe Dan would help by sending him a few people who are thirsty from eating too many cookies.

Question 34: He __34__ a proud businessman of a successful shaved ice shop.
questions.explanation: 第一句說 Jerry 這幾個月不開心，後面又說對面餅乾店搶走他一半生意，可知「成功的刨冰店老闆」是以前的事、現在已不是，要用 used to be（過去曾經是）。is 和 has been 表示現在仍是，與生意變差矛盾；was going to be 是「過去原本打算成為」，也不合文意。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following passage and choose the best answer for each blank.

Englishman Robert Scott is known for leading two trips to Antarctica. The first one made him a star; the second __38__.
After his first successful trip, Scott decided to be the first person to stand on the South Pole. However, __39__. He would be in a race with Roald Amundsen, from Norway. Both left their countries by ship in June of 1910 and arrived in Antarctica in January of 1911.
About ten months later, both teams started their trips down to the South Pole. __40__. Amundsen's team used dogs, and Scott's team used horses. Because horses weren't good at traveling on snow, it took Scott's team 77 days to arrive at the South Pole. They got there on January 17, 1912, and were surprised to find that Amundsen was ahead of them. The news hit Scott very hard, but what he didn't know was that __41__. His team began their long trip home with broken hearts. After days of terrible weather and little food, Scott lost his men one after another, and he himself was the last one to meet the end of his life. No one on his team lived to go back home and tell their story. It was only learned through Scott's diary.
[Map of Antarctica with the South Pole marked and a penguin illustration.]

Question 38: The first one made him a star; the second __38__.
questions.explanation: 文末說 Scott 的隊員一個接一個死去，他自己也是最後一個喪命的人，可知第二次南極之旅「讓他付出了生命」，選 cost him his life。和前句「第一次讓他成為明星」形成對比；他沒有搶到第一個抵達南極的夢想，所以 (D) 錯。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Look at the picture. The girl is _____ the clothes. [Picture: a girl bending over a bed, folding/packing clothes into boxes, with a jacket hanging on a rack nearby.]
questions.explanation: 圖中女孩正把衣服摺好放進紙箱裡，地上還有好幾個箱子，是在「打包、裝箱」，所以用 packing（pack 打包）。她沒有在洗衣服（washing），也不是在做衣服（making）或展示衣服（showing）。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: The _____ is so strong today that my hair keeps blowing in the air.
questions.explanation: 後半句說 my hair keeps blowing in the air（頭髮一直在空中飄），能把頭髮吹起來的是「風」，所以選 wind。rain、snow、sun 都不會讓頭髮一直被吹動。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: When the baby cried, Mr. Wu _____ in the kitchen and did not hear it.
questions.explanation: When the baby cried（過去某一刻）發生時，吳先生「正在」廚房做菜，所以沒聽到，要用過去進行式 was cooking 表示過去某時間點正在進行的動作。選 cooked 只表示做過這件事，無法表達「正在做而沒聽到」的情境。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: I don't have any money with me because I _____ my wallet this morning.
questions.explanation: this morning 是已經過去的時間點，錢包是在今天早上「弄丟」的，用簡單過去式 lost。had lost 是過去完成式，須有另一個更晚的過去時間做對照，這裡沒有；was losing 表示正在弄丟，不合理。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: You need not only good luck but also hard work to become a _____ baseball player.
questions.explanation: not only good luck but also hard work（不只要運氣還要努力）才能成為的，應該是「成功的」棒球選手，選 successful。young、happy、friendly 都跟運氣和努力無關。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: The woman who lives next door to Ken is a _____ to him. They have never met and he doesn't even know her name.
questions.explanation: 後句說他們從沒見過面，Ken 甚至不知道她的名字，所以這位鄰居對他來說是「陌生人」stranger。friend 與「從沒見過」矛盾。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: With the new bus line, it is much more _____ for Fanny to go to school. It saves her a lot of time now.
questions.explanation: 後句 It saves her a lot of time（幫她省下很多時間），表示新公車路線讓上學更「方便」，選 convenient。useful 通常形容東西有用，it is more useful for Fanny to go to school 語意不通；possible 則是「可能」，與省時無關。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Dad: Have you brushed your teeth yet?
Ann: No, but I _____ before I go to bed.
questions.explanation: Ann 說 No（還沒刷牙），but 表示轉折，接著說睡覺前「會」去刷，用 will（= will brush my teeth）。won't 與 but 的轉折語氣矛盾；haven't / have 是現在完成式，不能搭配未來的 before I go to bed。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Alice: Do you know _____ Grandma is going to visit us?
Willy: It's next week. She told me on the phone. And we'll take her to the national park.
questions.explanation: Willy 回答 It's next week（下星期），回答的是時間，所以 Alice 問的是奶奶「什麼時候」要來，選 when。這是間接問句 Do you know when + 主詞 + 動詞。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: It took the police lots of time _____ who entered Liu's house and killed her one year ago.
questions.explanation: 句型 It takes + 人 + 時間 + to V（某人花多少時間去做某事），所以用 to find out。其他選項都不符合這個固定句型。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Many famous people visit this restaurant. Popular singers like A-mei and Jay Chou _____ here with their friends.
questions.explanation: 主詞是 Popular singers like A-mei and Jay Chou，句子還缺主要動詞；歌手是「被看見」，要用被動語態 be + p.p.，主詞複數用 are often seen。A、B 都缺 be 動詞當主要動詞，D 多了 and，句子不完整。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: The factory has been throwing trash into the river for years. Now _____ must be taken to stop this.
questions.explanation: 工廠多年來把垃圾丟進河裡，現在必須「採取行動」阻止，固定用法 take action（被動 action must be taken）。chances、exercise、notes 都不能和 take 搭配出「阻止」的意思。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: The beach party tonight _____ the end of our summer vacation. Tomorrow we are all going back home and getting ready for school.
questions.explanation: 明天大家就要回家準備上學，所以今晚的海灘派對「標誌著」暑假的結束，mark 有「標示、代表」的意思。changes（改變）、passes（經過）、saves（拯救）都不合語意。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Anyone who reads Loren's business plan will quickly see some serious problems in it, or _____ feel something is not right.
questions.explanation: 讀過計畫的人會很快看出嚴重問題，或者「至少」會覺得有哪裡不對勁，at least 表示退一步的最低程度。even（甚至）是語氣加強，放在「感覺不對」這種較弱的情況前不合理。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: I've wanted to read The Diary of a Young Girl for months, _____ today I finally borrowed the book from the library.
questions.explanation: 前句「想讀這本書好幾個月了」，後句「今天終於借到了」，兩件事是順接關係，用 and 連接。so 表示因果，但「想讀很久」不是「今天借到」的原因；since、until 表時間，句意不通。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following passage and answer the question.

Robert likes to take a walk in the park after work. One day when he was walking in the park, he heard a woman calling his name. He stopped to look around, but didn't see anything __16__. Shortly after Robert saw it, it was gone.
Though Robert felt a little strange, he did not think about it too much and sat down for a rest on a bench in the park. Then he noticed the snake he had just seen __17__. Robert was too afraid to move away from the bench. Right at this moment, a woman behind him shouted, "Come here, Robert. You can't stay on the bench like that. __18__."
In surprise, Robert turned around and said to the woman, "Excuse me, but that's not a very nice thing to say, and in fact some people say I'm handsome."
"I'm not talking to you," said the woman. "I'm telling Robert, my pet snake, to get down from the bench, not you."

Question 16: Choose the best word(s) for blank __16__.
questions.explanation: 下一句 Shortly after Robert saw it, it was gone 用了 it，表示他確實看到了某個東西；第二段又提到 the snake he had just seen，所以他四處看時「除了一條小蛇以外什麼都沒看到」，選 except a little snake。其他選項都沒交代他看到的是蛇，後文的 it 和 the snake 就接不上。

questions.question_text:
Read the following passage and answer the question.

Question 17: Choose the best word(s) for blank __17__.
questions.explanation: 結尾女主人說要叫寵物蛇 Robert get down from the bench（從長椅上下來），可見蛇當時已經「爬上長椅」，選 climbing up the bench，也因此羅伯特嚇得不敢動。stopping beside his feet 只停在腳邊，和後文「從長椅上下來」不符。

questions.question_text:

Question 18: Choose the best sentence for blank __18__.

options.C: People will be scared by you
options.D: The paint of the bench is still wet

questions.explanation: 女人是在對蛇說話：蛇待在長椅上「會把人嚇到」，所以選 People will be scared by you。羅伯特誤以為在說他，才會回嘴說「這樣說不太禮貌，有人說我很帥」，正好證明那句話是在說「你會嚇到人」。長椅壞了或油漆未乾都不會讓他覺得被冒犯。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following passage and answer the question.

If you cannot live without your car, Zurich might be the last city you would like to visit. In Zurich, people are welcome, but cars are not! Over the past 20 years, this city has used smart ways __19__. One is to keep the same total number of parking spaces. For example, if 50 new parking spaces are built in one part of the city, then 50 old spaces in other parts are taken away for other uses. So the total number does not change. Some are unhappy that there are never enough spaces. That is just what the city has in mind: If people find parking more difficult, they will drive less.
__20__, the total number of cars in the city is counted. Over 3,500 little computers are put under Zurich roads to check the number of cars that enter the city. If the number is higher than the city can deal with, the traffic lights on the roads that enter the city will be kept red. So drivers who are traveling into Zurich have to stop and wait until there are fewer cars in the city. Now, you may wonder __21__. The answer is simple: The city wants to make more space for its people.

Question 19: Choose the best word(s) for blank __19__.

options.C: to make itself a famous city

questions.explanation: 全文講蘇黎世讓停車位總數不變、用紅燈擋住進城車輛，目的都是讓人少開車，也就是「讓交通變順暢、車流變少」，選 to make traffic lighter。D 剛好相反，文中說停車位總數維持不變，並沒有要蓋更多。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following passage (Edward's Travel Tips) and answer the question.

What kind of place do you usually choose to stay for the night during a trip? Expensive hotels that may make you feel like you don't get what you pay for? Or cheap hostels that put you and five other strangers in the same bedroom? If both choices sound terrible to you, here's something new: holiday apartments.
In a holiday apartment, you have more space than what a hotel room can give you. Everything in the apartment is at your disposal. The living room, the kitchen, the study, and, of course, the bedrooms are all for your own use. Some apartments even have a lovely garden or a game room. You'll feel at home in the holiday apartment. The best thing is, a holiday apartment is not expensive. The price for a holiday apartment is for two people, and the apartment is often cheaper than a hotel room for two. You only need to pay a little more for a third or fourth person. If you travel with friends or your family, a holiday apartment will be your best choice!
(hostel 提供廉價食宿的旅舍)

What is the reading mostly about?

options.A: Where to find a nice holiday apartment.
options.B: How to choose a nice holiday apartment.
options.C: Why one should choose a holiday apartment.
options.D: How one can change their house into a holiday apartment.

questions.explanation: 文章先點出飯店太貴、青年旅舍要和陌生人同房的缺點，再說明度假公寓空間大、設施都能用、價格便宜、適合結伴旅行，整篇都在說「為什麼該選度假公寓」，選 C。文中沒有教去哪裡找（A）或怎麼挑選（B）。

options.A: They are good for people who like to take one-day trips.

options.C: They are good for people who want to make new friends when traveling.
options.D: They are good for people who like to spend their holidays in the country.

options.A: You are free to use it.
options.D: You can buy it at a lower price.

questions.concept_tag: 上下文詞義與指代推測
questions.explanation: at your disposal 後面接著說客廳、廚房、書房、臥室 are all for your own use（全都給你自己使用），可推知意思是「可以自由使用」，選 A。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following passage (a flowchart titled "SHARP WEAR: A T-shirt like no other!") and answer the question.

SHARP WEAR: A T-shirt like no other! First time here? Don't worry! Here is our quick lesson for you!
[Flowchart:]
1. What kind of T-shirt do you like? (4 kinds of T-shirts to choose from!)
-> 2. What color for the T-shirt? (We have as many as 16 colors!)
-> 3. Want a picture on your T-shirt?
   -> "No, thank you." -> 4. Pocket? No pocket?
   -> "Oh yes! (Now choose from one of our 72 pictures or send us your own!)" -> 4. Pocket? No pocket?
4. Pocket? No pocket?
   -> "I don't need one." -> 6. Your size? (7 sizes for you!)
   -> "Of course! What kind of pocket then? (We've got 4 shapes for you!)" -> 5. How about a different color for the pocket?
5. How about a different color for the pocket?
   -> "No, thank you. Same color as the T-shirt." -> 6. Your size? (7 sizes for you!)
   -> "Why not? (Choose from the 16 colors AGAIN!)" -> 6. Your size? (7 sizes for you!)
6. Your size? (7 sizes for you!) -> 7. How many T-shirts do you want? -> 8. Finally, you can pay! :)

What is the quick lesson of SHARP WEAR about?

options.A: How to get to one of SHARP WEAR's stores.
options.B: How to send back a T-shirt to SHARP WEAR.
options.C: How to shop for a T-shirt from SHARP WEAR.
options.D: How to take care of a T-shirt from SHARP WEAR.

questions.explanation: 流程圖從選 T 恤款式、顏色、圖案、口袋、尺寸、數量，一直到最後 Finally, you can pay（付款），是在教第一次來的客人「怎麼購買一件 T 恤」，選 C。圖中沒有提到怎麼去門市、退貨或保養。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following poem and answer the question.

The sky is turning bright and clear.
The earth is wearing red and green.
Winter is gone; spring has come.
The air smells fresh and sweet.

The summer heat is not yet here;
A little fox comes out to play.
A bird is busy in a tree
Waking a daisy from her sleep.

Little daisy, little daisy,
People call the flower the "day's eye."
When she opens her eye,
The springtime brings us cheer.
(poem 詩)

Which season is this poem about?
questions.explanation: 詩中直接寫 Winter is gone; spring has come（冬天走了、春天來了），又說 The summer heat is not yet here（夏天的炎熱還沒到），最後一句也提到 springtime，所以描寫的是春天，選 Spring。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following poem and answer the question.

The sky is turning bright and clear.
The earth is wearing red and green.
Winter is gone; spring has come.
The air smells fresh and sweet.

The summer heat is not yet here;
A little fox comes out to play.
A bird is busy in a tree
Waking a daisy from her sleep.

Little daisy, little daisy,
People call the flower the "day's eye."
When she opens her eye,
The springtime brings us cheer.
(poem 詩)

What is a daisy?
questions.concept_tag: 上下文詞義與指代推測
questions.explanation: 第三段說 People call the flower the "day's eye"，這裡的 the flower 就是指前一行的 daisy，所以 daisy 是一種花（雛菊），選 C。容易誤選 B，但詩中是鳥在樹上把雛菊叫醒，鳥和雛菊是不同的東西。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following passage and answer the question.

When we get wet, we need a towel to get ourselves dry. When a dog gets wet, all it needs is to shake its body. A study in 2010 showed that a wet dog can throw off half the water on its body by shaking for less than a second. In fact, this common act of dogs works better than a washing machine.
The study found that animal shaking begins with the head and ends with the tail. During a shake, the animal's head, body and skin all move. Smaller animals must shake faster than bigger animals to get water off. For example, in one second, a rat can shake 18 times, a dog 6 times, and a bear 4 times. Bigger animals can get their bodies dry with fewer shakes.
For animals, shaking is not just about getting themselves dry. It is also about saving their lives. Being wet makes animals heavier, and that makes it harder to run. In the animal world, how fast an animal can run often decides whether it will live or not. Maybe that's why the "wet-dog shake" has become a common habit of many animals.
(skin 皮膚)

What does the reading say about shaking?

options.A: Different animals' shaking begins with different body parts.
options.B: Shaking is a way that animals use to make other animals scared.
options.C: Animals that are not kept as pets do the shaking better than those that are.
options.D: Shaking themselves dry may help animals run faster in dangerous moments.

questions.explanation: 第三段說全身濕會讓動物變重、跑不快，而在動物世界裡跑得快不快往往決定生死，所以甩乾身體可能幫助動物在危險時跑得更快，選 D。A 錯，文中說動物甩動都是從頭開始、到尾巴結束；B、C 文中都沒提到。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following passage and answer the question.

When we get wet, we need a towel to get ourselves dry. When a dog gets wet, all it needs is to shake its body. A study in 2010 showed that a wet dog can throw off half the water on its body by shaking for less than a second. In fact, this common act of dogs works better than a washing machine.
The study found that animal shaking begins with the head and ends with the tail. During a shake, the animal's head, body and skin all move. Smaller animals must shake faster than bigger animals to get water off. For example, in one second, a rat can shake 18 times, a dog 6 times, and a bear 4 times. Bigger animals can get their bodies dry with fewer shakes.
For animals, shaking is not just about getting themselves dry. It is also about saving their lives. Being wet makes animals heavier, and that makes it harder to run. In the animal world, how fast an animal can run often decides whether it will live or not. Maybe that's why the "wet-dog shake" has become a common habit of many animals.
(skin 皮膚)

What can we learn from the reading?

options.A: The animal's tail can help it run more quickly and easily.
options.B: Some animals shake more than they need to get water off.
options.C: The idea of washing machines came from the shaking of dogs.
options.D: Larger animals get themselves drier at each shake than smaller animals.

questions.explanation: 文中說 Bigger animals can get their bodies dry with fewer shakes（大型動物甩較少次就能乾），表示牠們每甩一次甩掉的水比小動物多，選 D。C 錯在文章只說狗甩水比洗衣機還有效，沒說洗衣機的構想來自狗。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following dialogue and answer the question.

Josh: Do you know about "pay it forward coffee" at Flora Café?
Eric: You mean you pay for a cup of coffee for someone poor to have it later?
Josh: Yeah. A cup of coffee is not much, but on cold winter days like today, it might warm them up a little. And maybe their hearts too.
Eric: But will Flora Café really give this cup of coffee to someone later?
Josh: Come on. I've known the shopkeeper well. He's an honest man. He's got a blackboard in the shop that says how many cups are paid for and how many have been given out.
Eric: But how will they know who to give? Anyone can ask for it, even if they're not poor.
Josh: True, but then I guess they'll just have to believe in people.
Eric: Perhaps. But will poor people go and ask for a free coffee? Won't they worry about losing face?
Josh: Why do you always say things like that?
Eric: Well, it may happen.
Josh: Yeah, I know, but I still think it's a good thing to do, and it gets people to care about others.

What does things like that mean?

options.A: Problems about the free coffee plan.
options.B: Trouble for people who go to Flora Café.
options.C: Ways to make the free coffee plan successful.
options.D: Good things free coffee will bring to Flora Café.

questions.concept_tag: 上下文詞義與指代推測
questions.explanation: Eric 前面一直在提疑問：咖啡店會不會真的把咖啡送出去、怎麼知道該給誰、窮人會不會怕丟臉而不敢拿，Josh 才問「你為什麼老是說這種話」。things like that 指的就是 Eric 對這個免費咖啡計畫提出的各種問題，選 A。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following passage and answer the question.

Jim Webb  Oct. 16, 1987
Over the years, the number of whales has dropped sharply. From 1946 to 1986, about 340,000 whales were killed. People worry that children in the future can only see whales in pictures. They believe all kinds of whaling (whale hunting) should be stopped before it's too late.
Some people are trying to stop whaling all over the world. But they fail to notice one fact: Whaling was going on for a long time before the number of whales went down and became a problem.
Whaling started as early as 1,500 years ago. This was how tribespeople fed their families. They hunted whales for meat because almost nothing could grow on their land. They also made whale fat into oil and used it to make candles or oil lamps. Over the years, whaling became their way of living, and even part of who they are.
Tribe whaling is not the thing we should worry about. Of all the whales that were killed over the past forty years, only 10% were hunted by tribespeople. The other 90% died at the hands of the money-making whaling business. When we try to stop all kinds of whaling, we should think what we are asking tribespeople to give up and whether this is the best answer to the problem of whaling.
(tribe 部落  fat 脂肪) (order 順序)

Below are the writer's points in the reading:
a. Whether we should stop tribespeople whaling
b. The problem of whaling
c. Whaling as a way of life
In what order does the writer talk about his points?
questions.explanation: 第一段講鯨魚數量銳減、有人主張全面禁止捕鯨，是「捕鯨的問題」(b)；第三段講部落從 1,500 年前就靠捕鯨維生，是「捕鯨作為生活方式」(c)；最後一段討論是否該要求部落放棄捕鯨 (a)。順序為 b→c→a，選 B。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following news story and answer the question.

NBN NEWS  Ryan Kim  7/15/2013
Guesses about Carolyn Cole have been flying around since last week, and now things have taken a new turn.
Last week Carolyn Cole won the Inscriber Prize, the country's biggest book prize, with her book Paper Soldier. Cole herself did not show up for the prize. It was not only the first time in history that a first-time writer won the prize, but also the first time that the winner did not appear.
Now here comes another "first time" for the Inscriber: Cole is not real. "She" is in fact Thomas Goode. Goode is known for his picture books. His best-known book, Blue Moon, won him two national book prizes and sold over one million copies.
Goode had tried to write "serious" books before. His first try was Parent, which came out in 2006. Sadly, Goode's big name did not help, and there was little interest in Parent. Goode's friend told NBN that he wanted to write a book under a different name. Goode thought that people might treat his book seriously if they did not know it was from a picture book writer.
For the moment, there has been no word from Goode yet.

From the news story, which fact is seen as a new turn?

options.A: Carolyn Cole is a first-time writer.
options.B: Carolyn Cole won the Inscriber Prize.
options.C: Carolyn Cole is not the winner's real name.
options.D: Carolyn Cole did not appear for the Inscriber Prize.

questions.explanation: 上週的新聞是 Cole 以新人身分得獎、且沒有現身領獎（A、B、D 都是之前就知道的事）；a new turn（新的轉折）指的是本週才揭露的消息：Cole is not real，其實是 Thomas Goode 用的另一個名字，選 C。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Look at the picture. The mother duck is _____ the baby ducks across the street. [Picture: a mother duck walks along a zebra crossing followed in a line by four baby ducks, all crossing the street together.]
questions.explanation: 圖中母鴨走在最前面，小鴨排成一列跟在後面過馬路，所以是母鴨「帶領」小鴨過街，lead sb. across the street＝帶某人穿越街道。carry 是抱著、背著，push 是推，watch 是在旁邊看，都和圖中母鴨走在前頭的樣子不符。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Ms. Liu usually gives us a lot of homework, _____ she didn't give us any today.
questions.explanation: 前句說劉老師「通常」給很多作業，後句說她今天「一份都沒給」，前後語意相反，要用表示轉折的 but。so 表結果、or 表選擇、if 表條件，都無法連接這兩個相反的事實。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Playing games on the cellphone _____ popular with high school students.
questions.concept_tag: 數量詞與主詞動詞一致
questions.explanation: 主詞是動名詞片語 Playing games on the cellphone（玩手機遊戲這件事），動名詞當主詞視為單數，所以動詞用 is。容易誤選 are，是被 games 或 students 等複數名詞誤導，但真正的主詞是 Playing。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: There _____ more than twenty clubs in our school. Which one would you like to join?
questions.concept_tag: 數量詞與主詞動詞一致
questions.explanation: 「There + be 動詞」表示「有…」，be 動詞要跟後面的名詞一致；後面是 more than twenty clubs（二十多個社團），為複數，所以用 are。has / have 不能和 There 連用表示「存在」。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Diane had a bad cold last week. She is still too _____ to go mountain climbing with you.
questions.explanation: Diane 上週得了重感冒，所以現在身體還太「虛弱」，不能去爬山；too + 形容詞 + to V＝太…而不能…。weak（虛弱的）與生病的前因最相符；busy、short、young 都和感冒沒有因果關係。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: The book under Mary's desk is _____, but I don't know why it is there.
questions.explanation: 空格在 is 後面當補語，且後面沒有名詞，要用所有格代名詞 mine（＝my book），意思是「那本書是我的」。my 是所有格形容詞，後面必須接名詞；us、me 是受格，語意不通。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Last night a garbage truck hit a tree and turned over. Now the street is _____ with lots of garbage.
questions.explanation: 垃圾車翻覆後，街道上滿是垃圾，所以街道很「髒」，be dirty with...＝因…而髒。dark（暗的）、heavy（重的）、poor（窮的）都無法描述被垃圾弄亂的街道。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: It almost killed Kevin to take care of his baby sister for one afternoon. He wondered how his mom could do _____ every day.
questions.explanation: 空格指的是前面提到的「照顧小妹妹」這整件事，代替一件事情要用單數代名詞 it。Kevin 只照顧一下午就快累死，所以他好奇媽媽怎麼能每天做「這件事」。her 會變成指妹妹或媽媽，do her 不合語意；them 是複數、one 代替同類名詞，都不對。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Joyce tells her brother everything. She never _____ anything from him.
questions.explanation: Joyce 什麼事都告訴哥哥，所以她從不「隱瞞」任何事情；hide sth. from sb.＝對某人隱藏某事。cover 是覆蓋，不和 from sb. 搭配表示隱瞞；believe、take 語意都不對。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Ben always uses his birthday as a(n) _____ to ask Dad to buy him something expensive.
questions.explanation: Ben 每次都拿生日當「藉口」要爸爸買貴的東西給他；use sth. as an excuse to V＝拿某事當作做某事的藉口。action（行動）、prize（獎品）、rule（規則）放進去語意都不通。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: _____ that last piece of pie? If not, can I have it? I didn't eat much this morning.
questions.explanation: 說話者接著問「如果不吃，我可以吃嗎？」，表示那塊派還在，是在問對方「等一下打算吃嗎」，要用表示未來打算的 be going to，所以選 Are you going to eat。Had you eaten（過去完成式）、Were you eating（過去進行式）都指過去；Do you eat 是問習慣，都不合情境。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Everyone in the class enjoys playing chess _____ Bill; he thinks the game is boring.
questions.explanation: 後半句說 Bill 覺得下棋很無聊，可見全班「除了」Bill 以外都喜歡下棋，所以用 except（除了…之外）。like 是「像」，for、of 放進句中都說不通。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: In my school days, I _____ to English radio programs every day. That was how I learned English at that time.
questions.explanation: In my school days（在我求學時期）是過去的一段時間，說的是當時每天聽英語廣播的習慣，而現在已經不是這樣了，要用 used to + 原形動詞（過去常常…）。listen 是現在式；have listened 是現在完成式，不能搭配明確的過去時間；was listening 是過去某時刻正在進行，不能表示「每天」的習慣。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Tom's voice _____ when he talks about his neighbors. He speaks faster, his face becomes redder and you can almost see fire in his eyes.
questions.explanation: 後句描述 Tom 講話變快、臉變紅、眼中冒火，表示他一談到鄰居就生氣、激動，聲音會「提高」，用 rises。drops 是聲音降低，和生氣相反；appears（出現）、grows（成長）不用來形容聲音變大。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: _____ other waiters in the restaurant have worked here longer than Clark; only Lois and Lana started working here before him.
questions.concept_tag: 數量詞與主詞動詞一致
questions.explanation: 分號後說「只有 Lois 和 Lana 比他早來工作」，也就是比 Clark 資歷久的其他服務生只有兩位，數量很少，所以用 Few（很少、幾乎沒有）。All、Most 表示全部或大多數，和「只有兩人」矛盾；Some 雖然是「一些」，但無法呈現「只有」的限定語氣。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the poem below, then answer the question.

Making goulash
we don't talk much,
Daddy and me.

"The talking's in the making, son," he smiles.
I see what he means.

It's in the knife
meeting the beef,

in the dancing of potatoes
as they turn in the water,
in the singing
of boiling soup in the pot.

There are enough words
in the way
Daddy teaches me his famous dish
and the way he hugs me
when we finish.

Making goulash
we don't talk much,
Daddy and me,

but everything is said.

(Ideas from Candace Pearson's poem)

What are "Daddy and me" doing in the poem?
questions.explanation: 詩中出現 knife meeting the beef（刀切牛肉）、potatoes turn in the water（馬鈴薯在水中翻滾）、boiling soup in the pot（鍋裡滾沸的湯），還有 Daddy teaches me his famous dish（爸爸教我做他的拿手菜），可知父子倆正在一起做菜，選 Cooking。詩裡的 dancing、singing 是比喻馬鈴薯翻滾和湯滾的聲音，不是真的在唱歌跳舞，別被字面誤導。

What can we most likely know about the speaker?

options.B: He enjoys his time with his father.
options.C: He often makes goulash for his father.
options.D: He wants to be as famous as his father.

questions.explanation: 說話者說「我懂他的意思」、雖然兩人話不多「但一切盡在不言中」，還寫到做完菜爸爸會擁抱他，可以感受到他很享受和父親相處的時光，選 B。A 與 I see what he means 相反；C、D 詩中沒提到他常煮給父親吃或想跟父親一樣有名（famous 是形容爸爸的拿手菜）。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the City Sight Bus notice below, then answer the question.

City Sight Bus (www.citysightbus.org) map shows two round-trip routes starting and ending at Central Station: Line A (dotted line, marked with a small arrow) runs Central Station - Westside Church - Starlight Garden - Great Age Theater - City Square - King James' Castle - Lovers' Bridge - East-End Temple - back to Central Station. Line B (dashed gray line, marked with a small arrow) runs Central Station - Farmers' Bridge - Queen Marguerite's Park - King Henry's Castle - King Henry's Garden - Lovers' Bridge - back to Central Station.

OPENING HOURS
- High Season (April to September): 9:00-18:00 every day
- Low Season (October to March): 9:00-17:00 every day

TICKET PRICES
- Line A (dotted arrow): $20 each person
- Line B (dashed arrow): $18 each person

THINGS YOU SHOULD KNOW
- Buses for both lines leave every hour from Central Station.
- Line A takes one hour; Line B takes 50 minutes.
- If you are taking your pet with you, please buy a seat for it at half price.
- Save 10% if you buy tickets on the Internet.
- Save 10% if you buy tickets for both lines.
- Go to www.citysightbus.org for more information.

Which is true about City Sight Bus tickets?

options.A: It costs less to buy tickets on the Internet.
options.B: People must pay the full ticket price for a pet.
options.C: Tickets are more expensive in the high season.
options.D: People save 10% if they buy two tickets for the same line.

questions.explanation: 告示寫 Save 10% if you buy tickets on the Internet，上網買票可省 10%，所以網路購票比較便宜，選 A。B 錯，寵物座位只要半價；C 錯，票價只分路線（A 線 $20、B 線 $18），旺季淡季只差營業時間；D 錯，打九折的條件是「兩條路線都買」，不是同一條路線買兩張。
questions.text_issue: JSON 對地圖路線的文字描述有誤：依原圖，A 線（點線）是從 Lovers' Bridge 經 Grand Castle of King Charles 附近回 Central Station，East-End Temple 其實在 B 線（虛線）上，B 線是 Lovers' Bridge→East-End Temple→Central Station；描述把 East-End Temple 誤歸 A 線。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the dialogue below, then answer the question.

Sarah: You're VERY popular today. I've had seventeen calls asking for you.
Mike: Finally! After all these years of kicking and running, I've got my own fans! So what did they want? My photos? Do I need to sign my name? Are they starting a fan club for me?
Sarah: Well, let me ask you this: What day was yesterday?
Mike: Friday... Why?
Sarah: Did you forget something?
Mike: Did I forget... OH, NO! I didn't pick up my soccer team's sport shirts from the shop! And we're having this big game tomorrow!
Sarah: Yeah. And from what I've heard, it's your team's most important game this season.
Mike: OK. I have to go fix this now.
Sarah: Too late. They've tried. It's not open on the weekend. And if you want to know, they are Johnny, Ricky, Archie, Freddie...
Mike: I know, I know, everyone on my team. Oh, I'm a dead man now.
Sarah: Yeah, that was what they said on the phone, seventeen times.

Why were there seventeen calls asking for Mike?

options.A: His team was angry at him.
options.B: He is a popular soccer player.
options.C: He did not show up for the game on Friday.
options.D: His name did not appear on the list of players.

questions.explanation: Mike 忘了去店裡拿球隊的球衣，隔天就是本季最重要的比賽，打電話來的正是他的隊友，Mike 自己也說 I'm a dead man now，Sarah 說電話裡他們也這麼說了十七次，可見隊友都很生氣，選 A。B 是 Mike 一開始自己誤會有粉絲；C 錯，比賽是「明天」，不是星期五。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the passage below, then answer the question.

Animals have their special ways to deal with hard times in nature. The superb fairy-wren, one kind of bright-blue bird in Australia, is one example. This year, a ten-year study showed that this small bird has eggs of different sizes in different kinds of weather. When the weather is hot and dry, there is less food for young superb fairy-wrens, and they die easily. So the mother bird will make larger eggs to help her babies grow stronger inside before they break out of the eggs into the "hungry" world.
However, not all mother birds are able to do this trick. Only those with at least one male child can. When the weather is "good," the mother will make smaller eggs, and her sons will bring food back for their baby brothers and sisters from the eggs. With her sons' help, the mother can save more energy to make larger eggs when the weather is bad. Isn't this amazing?

Which is the best title for this reading?

options.A: Australia: The Best Place for Birds.
options.C: Larger Mother Birds Have Larger Eggs.
options.D: Family Love: Brothers & Sisters Work Together.

questions.explanation: 文章重點是：天氣又熱又乾、食物變少時，母鳥會生比較大的蛋，讓幼鳥更強壯；天氣好時則生小蛋、省下力氣，也就是母鳥用改變蛋的大小來「對抗天氣變化」，選 B。C 錯，蛋的大小取決於天氣，不是母鳥體型；D 只提到哥哥幫忙餵食這個細節，不是全文主旨；A 文中沒有比較澳洲是否最適合鳥類。

What does this trick mean in the reading?

options.C: Saving food for weaker baby birds.

questions.concept_tag: 上下文詞義與指代推測
questions.explanation: this trick 承接上一段：母鳥會依天氣好壞生出大小不同的蛋（天氣差生大蛋、天氣好生小蛋），所以 this trick 指「生不同大小的蛋」，選 A。B 長得更強壯是大蛋帶來的結果，不是母鳥耍的「把戲」；C、D 都不是前文描述的做法。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Here are two pieces of news that Annie collected for her report.

Piece 1: Papier-mache is works of art that are made of paper. In Taiwan, it is known as zhizha and is usually burned as a gift for dead people. Taiwan's papier-mache is dying because it is not much needed now. However, this dying art won a Frenchman's heart when he visited the island. He then invited one of the papier-mache shops, Hsin Hsin Paper Offering Store, to show their beautiful works in France. The shop owner's son also used papier-mache in a way that no one ever thought of--making a movie with it.

Piece 2: Stan Lai is very important in Taiwan's theater. He brought changes to Chinese theater art of the old days to make it closer to our life experiences and easier to understand. One of his most famous works is That Evening, We Performed Crosstalk (1985). It was such a smash hit that people became interested again in xiangsheng, a show of funny talk between two actors. This art used to be a hobby that only a few people shared, but Lai has opened a bigger market for it. Now it has fans across all ages.

What idea is talked about in both pieces of news?

options.A: More young people need to join in making art.
options.B: People's ways of enjoying art change with time.
options.C: Bringing important art works to Taiwan from abroad.
options.D: Giving new life to old arts that were almost forgotten.

questions.explanation: 第一則說快要消失的紙紮藝術因法國人邀展、老闆兒子拿來拍電影而重獲注意；第二則說賴聲川讓原本只有少數人喜歡的相聲重新受到各年齡層歡迎，兩則都在講「讓幾乎被遺忘的傳統藝術重獲新生」，選 D。C 錯，紙紮是從台灣帶到法國展出，方向相反；A、B 兩則都沒有提到。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the VOF News article below (16/01/2015), then answer the question.

For many people, having a cup of coffee right out of bed is the best way to start a day. But a report from Asap Science says otherwise. It says the worst time for coffee is soon after we get up. When we wake up, our bodies start to make cortisol. Cortisol helps us to think clearly and be quick to understand and act. The cortisol levels rise after we wake up and climb to the highest in about an hour. So there are two problems when we drink coffee during this time: (1) our bodies will make less cortisol, and (2) the cortisol will make coffee less useful. And that's why some of us drink more and more coffee.
Then, when's the best time to have coffee? When the cortisol levels are going down, the report says. Cortisol levels are usually highest between 8 a.m. and 9 a.m., between noon and 1 p.m., and between 5:30 p.m. and 6:30 p.m. So if you want to have coffee, enjoy it after these times, and this popular drink will help you the most.

Which idea is talked about in the news?

options.A: How often we should drink coffee.
options.B: What happens when we have too much coffee.
options.C: How to help the body make the cortisol we need.
options.D: What happens when we have coffee at the wrong time.

questions.explanation: 新聞說起床後馬上喝咖啡是最糟的時機，會讓身體少製造皮質醇、咖啡也變得比較沒效，接著說明皮質醇下降時才是喝咖啡的好時機，重點在「在錯誤時間喝咖啡會怎樣」，選 D。A 講喝的頻率、B 講喝太多，文中都沒談；C 文中沒有教怎麼幫身體製造皮質醇。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the VOF News article below (16/01/2015), then answer the question.

For many people, having a cup of coffee right out of bed is the best way to start a day. But a report from Asap Science says otherwise. It says the worst time for coffee is soon after we get up. When we wake up, our bodies start to make cortisol. Cortisol helps us to think clearly and be quick to understand and act. The cortisol levels rise after we wake up and climb to the highest in about an hour. So there are two problems when we drink coffee during this time: (1) our bodies will make less cortisol, and (2) the cortisol will make coffee less useful. And that's why some of us drink more and more coffee.
Then, when's the best time to have coffee? When the cortisol levels are going down, the report says. Cortisol levels are usually highest between 8 a.m. and 9 a.m., between noon and 1 p.m., and between 5:30 p.m. and 6:30 p.m. So if you want to have coffee, enjoy it after these times, and this popular drink will help you the most.

What does it mean when someone thinks otherwise about something?

options.B: They have no idea about it.
options.D: They do not think it is a problem.

questions.concept_tag: 上下文詞義與指代推測
questions.explanation: 前一句說很多人認為起床就喝咖啡是一天最好的開始，But 後面說報告 says otherwise，接著說起床後反而是最糟的時間，意見正好相反，所以 otherwise 是「想法不同、持相反看法」，選 C。由 But 這個轉折字就能判斷前後意思相反。

The picture below shows how the cortisol levels rise and fall during the day (a line graph of cortisol levels in mg/dl from midnight to midnight, with four labeled points: point A is on the rising slope around 6-7 a.m. before the sharp peak; point B is on the steep upward slope just before the peak, around 7-8 a.m.; point C is at the very top of the sharp peak, around 8-9 a.m.; point D is on a falling slope of a smaller afternoon bump, pointing down around 4-5 p.m.).
