Four people read the news and wrote what they thought about it (under "What do you think?"):
Mike (Jan 16, 8:26 pm): "The best time to drink coffee is when you want to drink coffee."
Sarah (Jan 16, 8:43 pm): "I usually wake up AFTER I drink coffee!"
Charlie (Jan 16, 8:59 pm): "The worst time to drink coffee is when you're DEAD."
Lisa (Jan 16, 9:18 pm): "If you need someone to tell you when to drink coffee, well, that's just sad."

What did they think about the news?

options.A: They wanted to try what it said.
options.B: They were sad about what it said.
options.C: They did not agree with what it said.
options.D: They were not surprised at what it said.

questions.explanation: 四則留言都在唱反調：Mike 說想喝時就是最佳時間，Sarah 說她喝了咖啡才醒得來，Charlie 開玩笑說死了才是最糟時間，Lisa 說喝咖啡還要人教時間很可悲，可見他們都不認同新聞的說法，選 C。Lisa 留言中的 sad 是在嘲諷，不是因新聞內容感到難過，別誤選 B。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Below is part of a new shopping center's market report.

Our busiest time is weekend afternoons, between 1:30 p.m. and 3:30 p.m. About half the business of the week is done then. So it would be better if we move Weekend's Best Buy from Saturday evening to Saturday afternoon when there may be more shoppers during the sale. We should also think about having more free buses during the weekend, as 75% of the shoppers who were interviewed said two buses an hour are just not enough.
Weekend evenings are second busiest, though it is not as good as last season. An interesting fact is that business is better on weekday evenings, usually one hour before closing, than on weekend mornings. Most of the shoppers then are people who live near or working parents who do their last-minute shopping. They together make up almost 60% of the business on weekday evenings. It might bring in more business if we open half an hour longer during weekdays, until 10:30 p.m.

What does the report NOT suggest?

options.A: Having more free buses for shoppers.
options.B: Changing the opening hours on weekdays.
options.C: Making plans to help weekday morning business.
options.D: Changing the time of the special sale on weekends.

questions.explanation: 報告提出三項建議：把週末特賣從週六晚上改到週六下午（D）、週末增加免費接駁車（A）、平日延長營業半小時到 10:30（B）。報告只比較了平日晚上和「週末早上」的生意，完全沒提到要改善「平日早上」的生意，所以沒建議的是 C。

questions.question_text:

What does the report say about the shopping center?

options.D: A large part of its shoppers on weekday evenings are working parents.

questions.explanation: 報告說平日晚上的顧客大多是住附近的人或下班後來做最後採買的上班族父母，兩者合計約占平日晚上生意的 60%，可見上班族父母占了很大一部分，選 D。A 錯，不如上一季的是「週末晚上」；B 錯，文中沒有每天打烊前一小時特賣；C 錯，75% 是受訪者覺得接駁車班次不夠，不是搭車的比例。

Below is part of a new shopping center's market report.

Our busiest time is weekend afternoons, between 1:30 p.m. and 3:30 p.m. About half the business of the week is done then. Which picture (pie chart titled "Business done during a week" with 5 categories: Weekday evening, Weekend morning, Weekend afternoon, Weekend evening, Others) is most likely used in the report?

options.A: Pie chart: Weekday evening 15%, Weekend morning 10%, Weekend afternoon 24%, Weekend evening 48%, Others 3%.
options.B: Pie chart: Weekday evening 15%, Weekend morning 10%, Weekend afternoon 48%, Weekend evening 24%, Others 3%.
options.C: Pie chart: Weekday evening 24%, Weekend morning 10%, Weekend afternoon 48%, Weekend evening 15%, Others 3%.

questions.explanation: 依報告判斷：週末下午約占一週生意的一半→48%；週末晚上第二忙→24%；平日晚上生意比週末早上好→平日晚上 15% 大於週末早上 10%。完全符合的是 B。A 把週末晚上標成 48%；C 平日晚上 24% 反而比週末晚上多；D 平日晚上 10% 比週末早上 15% 少，都與報告矛盾。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the letter below, then choose the best answer for the blank marked 36.

Dear Maggie,
I know you won't be happy but I still have to say this again. It hurts me to think that you're going to __36__. I know you've always wanted to be like those actresses with big eyes and slim legs, but in fact you are already beautiful. What you are born with makes you special because nobody looks the same as you.
It worries me more that __37__. But sadly, there's no quick fix to this, not even with the doctor's help. If you don't try to like yourself first, no one else will. People like you not because of your face, but because of your heart. You need to understand this first. Until you understand this, nothing is going to be different even if you have this change.
I truly hope you think this through again.
Love,
Linda
questions.explanation: 後文說 Maggie 一直想變得像大眼睛、長腿的女演員，但 Linda 認為她本來就很美、天生的樣子讓她很特別，還提到醫生幫忙和 even if you have this change，可推知 Maggie 想去整形，也就是「改變自己原本的樣子」，選 A。B、C、D 都和外貌無關，接不上後面的說明。

options.A: you're too shy to talk with people
options.B: you just don't want to be like others
options.C: you don't think you're good enough

questions.explanation: 空格後說這個問題連醫生也無法快速解決，並強調「如果你不先試著喜歡自己，就沒人會喜歡你」，可知 Linda 更擔心的是 Maggie 覺得自己不夠好、缺乏自信，選 C。A 害羞、B 不想跟別人一樣、D 不知道錯過什麼，都和「喜歡自己」的勸告對不上；B 更與 Maggie 想變得像女演員相反。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the passage below, then choose the best answer for the blank marked 38.

Elizabeth Alexandra Mary Windsor was born in London on April 21, 1926. No one thought one day she __38__ the queen of the UK. After her grandfather, King George V, died in 1936, Elizabeth's uncle, Prince Edward, became King Edward VIII. Edward __39__ in love with a married American woman long before, and he decided to marry her after he became the king. However, Edward was asked to choose between the throne and his love. Finally, he decided to give up the throne.
__40__. After Edward VIII gave up the throne, Elizabeth's father became King George VI. As the oldest child without any brothers, Elizabeth became next in line to the throne. She needed to say goodbye to her good old life and prepare to be a queen. After her father died in 1952, she became Queen Elizabeth II.
Ever since she became head of her country, Queen Elizabeth II __41__: She has held meetings with important people in the UK, and has visited many foreign countries. In the few hours she keeps to herself, however, she reads and enjoys horseback riding.
questions.explanation: No one thought（過去式）表示「當時沒人想到」，而她成為女王是「當時之後」才發生的事，要用過去未來式 would + 原形動詞，選 would become。became 只是單純敘述過去事實，無法表達「從當時看來將來會…」；has become、had become 時間關係都不對。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the passage below, then choose the best answer for the blank marked 39.

Elizabeth Alexandra Mary Windsor was born in London on April 21, 1926. No one thought one day she __38__ the queen of the UK. After her grandfather, King George V, died in 1936, Elizabeth's uncle, Prince Edward, became King Edward VIII. Edward __39__ in love with a married American woman long before, and he decided to marry her after he became the king. However, Edward was asked to choose between the throne and his love. Finally, he decided to give up the throne.
__40__. After Edward VIII gave up the throne, Elizabeth's father became King George VI. As the oldest child without any brothers, Elizabeth became next in line to the throne. She needed to say goodbye to her good old life and prepare to be a queen. After her father died in 1952, she became Queen Elizabeth II.
Ever since she became head of her country, Queen Elizabeth II __41__: She has held meetings with important people in the UK, and has visited many foreign countries. In the few hours she keeps to herself, however, she reads and enjoys horseback riding.
questions.explanation: 句中有 long before，表示 Edward 愛上那位女子，發生在「他成為國王（過去）」之前很久，比過去更早發生的事要用過去完成式 had + p.p.，選 had fallen。has fallen 是現在完成式，is falling 是現在進行式，would fall 是過去未來，時間順序都不符。

After her grandfather, King George V, died in 1936, Elizabeth's uncle, Prince Edward, became King Edward VIII. Edward __39__ in love with a married American woman long before, and he decided to marry her after he became the king. However, Edward was asked to choose between the throne and his love. options.B: It was not easy to give up the throne
options.C: It was good news to Elizabeth and her family
options.D: This part of history made the UK a strong country

questions.explanation: 空格後面說 Edward 退位後，Elizabeth 的父親當上國王，她成了王位繼承人，得告別原本的生活、準備當女王，都在說明這件事如何「改變了 Elizabeth 的人生」，選 A。B 講放棄王位不容易，是上一段 Edward 的事，接不上後文；C、D 文中沒有依據。

questions.question_text:
Read the passage below, then choose the best answer for the blank marked 41.

Elizabeth Alexandra Mary Windsor was born in London on April 21, 1926. No one thought one day she __38__ the queen of the UK. After her grandfather, King George V, died in 1936, Elizabeth's uncle, Prince Edward, became King Edward VIII. Edward __39__ in love with a married American woman long before, and he decided to marry her after he became the king. However, Edward was asked to choose between the throne and his love. Finally, he decided to give up the throne.
__40__. After Edward VIII gave up the throne, Elizabeth's father became King George VI. As the oldest child without any brothers, Elizabeth became next in line to the throne. She needed to say goodbye to her good old life and prepare to be a queen. After her father died in 1952, she became Queen Elizabeth II.
Ever since she became head of her country, Queen Elizabeth II __41__: She has held meetings with important people in the UK, and has visited many foreign countries. In the few hours she keeps to herself, however, she reads and enjoys horseback riding.

options.A: has worked hard for the UK
options.B: has been popular with the people of the UK
options.C: has been the queen of the UK for a long time
options.D: has brought the people of the UK much closer

questions.explanation: 冒號後面具體說明她做的事：和英國重要人士開會、出訪許多國家，而且自己的時間只有少少幾小時（the few hours she keeps to herself），可見她一直「為英國努力工作」，選 A。B、D 文中沒有提到人民的反應；C 雖然是事實，但無法由冒號後的「做了哪些工作」來說明。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Look at the picture. The man is holding one of the _____.
questions.explanation: 圖中男子手上拿的是高腳杯（酒杯），英文是 glass，複數 glasses。one of the + 複數名詞表示「其中之一」。桌上雖然也有碗、盤子和湯匙，但他手中拿的是杯子，所以選 (B)。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: My mom puts the _____ on to keep her hands away from water when she washes the dishes.
questions.explanation: 關鍵在 keep her hands away from water（讓手不碰到水）和 washes the dishes（洗碗），洗碗時戴在手上防水的是手套 gloves。put on 是「穿戴」，jacket（夾克）、ring（戒指）、socks（襪子）都不能保護雙手不碰水，所以選 (A)。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Can you _____ your feet a little off the floor? I want to see if my keys are under the sofa.
questions.explanation: 後句說想看看鑰匙是不是在沙發底下，所以要請對方把腳「抬起來」離開地面，raise 是「舉起、抬高」。check（檢查）、kick（踢）、show（展示）都不符合 your feet a little off the floor 的意思，所以選 (C)。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: _____ of my sisters are older than I am. I'm the youngest of the three children in my family.
questions.concept_tag: 數量詞與主詞動詞一致
questions.explanation: 後句說「我是家中三個小孩裡最小的」，所以除了我之外剛好有兩個姊姊，兩個都比我大，要用 Both（兩者都）。Few、Most、Some 都用在三者以上或數量不確定的情況，不符合「剛好兩個」的語意，所以選 (A)。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: The beach near our town is a very _____ place. Every summer at least one kid dies there in the water.
questions.explanation: 後句說每年夏天至少有一個小孩在那裡的水中喪命（dies），可見那片海灘很「危險」，dangerous 最合理。exciting（刺激的）、lonely（孤單的）、popular（受歡迎的）都無法和「有人溺死」呼應，所以選 (A)。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: My wife enjoys going to the movies with her friends, but I like to watch TV at home by _____.
questions.explanation: by oneself 是固定用法，意思是「獨自、自己一個人」，主詞是 I，所以用反身代名詞 myself。句意是太太喜歡和朋友去看電影，但我喜歡一個人在家看電視。介系詞 by 後面不能接主格 I，by me / by mine 也沒有「獨自」的意思，所以選 (C)。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: For the past twenty years, my father _____ in a school library. But he'll leave the job next month.
questions.explanation: For the past twenty years（過去二十年來）表示從過去一直持續到現在，要用現在完成式 has worked。後句說他下個月才要離職，表示他到現在都還在做這份工作。(A) 過去式表示已經結束，(C)(D) 無法搭配「過去二十年來」，所以選 (B)。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: It's great that we can buy train tickets over the phone without going out. It _____ us a lot of time.
questions.explanation: 前句說可以用電話買車票、不用出門，這樣能「節省」很多時間，save sb. time 是「替某人省下時間」。takes us a lot of time 意思相反（花掉我們很多時間）；lends（借出）、prepares（準備）也不合語意，所以選 (C)。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Mozart _____ his first music when he was only six years old.
questions.explanation: when he was only six years old 說明這是過去某個時間點發生的事，要用過去式 wrote。現在完成式 has written 不能和明確的過去時間連用，is writing、will write 的時態也不對，所以選 (D)。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Jill: Have you decided _____ you will celebrate your 30th birthday?
Sue: Yeah, I'm going to have a big barbecue party.
questions.explanation: Sue 回答「我要辦一場大型烤肉派對」，說的是慶祝的「方式」，所以 Jill 問的是 how（如何）慶祝。如果問 where 或 when，回答應該是地點或時間；what 後面的子句需要缺一個受詞，但 you will celebrate your 30th birthday 已經完整，所以選 (A)。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Alison doesn't like _____ what to do. She only does things she wants to do.
questions.explanation: like 後面可接不定詞 to V；而後句說她只做自己想做的事，表示她不喜歡「被別人告知」該做什麼，要用被動語態 be told，合起來就是 to be told。(B) to tell 是主動，意思變成她不喜歡告訴別人；(A)(C) 形式不能直接接在 like 後面，所以選 (D)。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Josh has planned to make a trip to New York and _____ some of his friends there.
questions.explanation: and 連接兩個對等的動作：planned to make a trip ... and (to) visit some of his friends，to 可以省略，所以用原形動詞 visit。visits、visiting、visited 都無法和前面的 to make 對等，所以選 (A)。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Ms. Johnson has been taking phone calls since she entered the office this morning. Just when she thought she could finally leave work, _____ call came in.
questions.explanation: 她從早上一直在接電話，正以為可以下班時，「又」來了一通電話，表示在很多通之外再多一通，要用 another（另一個、再一個）。the other 用在只有兩個中的另一個；each（每一個）、the next（下一個）語意不如 another 貼切，所以選 (A)。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: We were so sure that Jerry _____ well on the difficult job. His past experience in other work showed he was the right guy for it. So when he failed, no one believed it.
questions.explanation: We were so sure 是過去式，當時是「預料」Jerry 將會做得很好，從過去的角度看未來要用 would do。後句說他後來失敗了，大家都不敢相信，證明這是事前的預期。had done、did、has done 都表示事情已經發生，不符合「預測」的語意，所以選 (D)。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: For Mike, the price is _____ important thing when he shops for jeans. He cares even more about the shape and the size of the pockets.
questions.explanation: 後句說 Mike 更在意牛仔褲的版型和口袋大小，可見價格是他買牛仔褲時「最不重要」的事，用最高級 the least important。the most 意思相反；the more / the less 是比較級，要有兩者比較才用，這裡沒有 than，所以選 (D)。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the poem below.

When it arrives,
Everyone cheers.
The shirts and shorts dance
On the clothesline,
The trees and flowers wave
Like they're saying hi,
And the clouds are so excited
To have a running race.

When it comes,
Dad's face falls.
His coat and jeans jump
Off the clothesline
Into the pond.
The tree leaves hop off
And have a party on his new car.

When it gets here,
A lot of fun things I notice:
The pond's face,
Sad and old with lines;
Mrs. Smith's bread,
Delicious and freshly baked.
But what smell is it?
Oh, no, it's from Mr. Brown's feet!

(leaf (leaves) 葉子)

What is it in the reading?
questions.concept_tag: 上下文詞義與指代推測
questions.explanation: 詩中的 it 一來，衣服在曬衣繩上「跳舞」、樹和花在「揮手」、雲在「賽跑」；接著衣褲被吹離曬衣繩掉進池塘、樹葉飛落到車上；池塘表面出現皺紋、還聞到麵包香和腳臭味被吹過來。這些都是「風」吹動東西、傳送氣味的現象，所以選 (C) The wind。太陽、雨、彩虹都不會把衣服吹進池塘。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the group chat below.

Group: Buffy, Debby, Jamie, Albert, Matt....(7)
Buffy: Hey, guys! I have a lot of things I don't need, so I'm thinking about having a yard sale. What do you think?
Buffy: [sticker of a cat] Thank you!
Debby: Having a yard sale is not easy. You have to collect things, put prices on them, put them out on tables and then wait for people to come. And usually you have to sell things at VERY low prices. For all that time and work, you make very little money. Why not just sell your things online for higher prices?
Jamie: Debby's right. But I think it'd be even better to just give your things to people who need them. I just sent out a lot of things last week.
Albert: Hey, I love yard sales! It's a great chance to make big money if you pick the right day. In my experience, Saturday is the best.
Matt: I agree with Albert. You can make money and meet interesting people. I made some good friends at my last yard sale.

What can we learn about Buffy's friends?

options.A: Matt has experience of yard sales.
options.B: Jamie had a successful yard sale last week.
options.C: Albert thinks weather is important for yard sales.
options.D: Debby thinks things are cheaper online than at yard sales.

questions.explanation: Matt 說 I made some good friends at my last yard sale.（我在上次的跳蚤市場交了好朋友），表示他辦過 yard sale，有相關經驗，所以選 (A)。Jamie 上週是把東西送人，不是辦拍賣；Albert 認為重要的是挑對日子（星期六），不是天氣；Debby 說網路上可以賣到「較高」的價格，不是比較便宜。

questions.question_text:
Here is an ad for Sunny Market.

From Jan. 4 to Feb. 4, for each $50 you spend (on anything EXCEPT books and CDs) at Sunny Market, you'll get a Sunny Sun picture. (2 pictures for every $100, 3 pictures for every $150, ...)

★ Collect 12 pictures, and you can get a Sunny Cup for free!
★ Collect 10 pictures, and you can get any of the desserts on the right for free!
★ Collect 6 pictures, and you can buy a Sunny Cup for $200, or any of the desserts on the right for $100!
☺ From Jan. 4 to Feb. 10, you can use Sunny Sun pictures to get Sunny Cups or desserts.

With Sunny Sun pictures, you can get one of the prizes below for free or at low prices!!
□ Sunny Cup   □ Chocolate
□ Fruitcake   □ Ice cream

From the ad, which is true about Sunny Sun pictures?

options.A: The first day to use Sunny Sun pictures is Feb. 4.
options.B: The last day to collect Sunny Sun pictures is Feb. 10.
options.C: You cannot use Sunny Sun pictures to get free desserts.
options.D: You cannot get Sunny Sun pictures when you buy books.

questions.explanation: 廣告寫明消費 $50 可得一張 Sunny Sun 圖片，但括號強調 EXCEPT books and CDs（書和 CD 除外），所以買書拿不到圖片，選 (D)。(A) 從 1 月 4 日就能開始使用；(B) 收集圖片的最後一天是 2 月 4 日，2 月 10 日是兌換截止日；(C) 集滿 10 張就能免費換甜點。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Now I'm going to show you how to work with chocolate. I'll do it in a "bain-marie," or, well, some people call it "water bath." I myself love the name "bain-marie." To make a "bain-marie," you need two pots, one bigger than the other.
First, break the chocolate into small pieces and put them in the smaller pot. Usually when making chocolate desserts, you'll need to mix chocolate with butter and sugar. So if you do, put them in the pot too.
Now, half fill the bigger pot with warm water. Put the smaller pot over the bigger one, and start to slowly mix the chocolate, the butter, and the sugar together. Keep the water under 50°C, or the chocolate may lose its shine. And make sure that no water goes in the smaller pot, or the chocolate will become hard and cannot be used.
Keep mixing for about five to ten minutes, and the job is done. Easy, right?
(mix 混合)

From the reading, which picture best shows the "bain-marie" way of working with chocolate? (Each option is a diagram of pots.)

options.A: (圖) A smaller pot containing (butter)(sugar)chocolate AND warm water together, placed inside a bigger pot also filled with warm water.
options.B: (圖) A smaller pot containing only (butter)(sugar)chocolate (no water), placed inside a bigger pot filled with warm water.
options.C: (圖) An arrow pours a pot of (butter)chocolate down into another pot that already has (sugar) and warm water in it.
options.D: (圖) An arrow pours a pot of warm water down into another pot that has (butter)(sugar)chocolate in it.

questions.explanation: 文中說巧克力（加奶油、糖）放在小鍋，大鍋裝一半溫水，再把小鍋放在大鍋上攪拌，而且要確保 no water goes in the smaller pot（小鍋裡不能進水）。(B) 小鍋只有巧克力、奶油、糖，外面大鍋是溫水，最符合。(A) 小鍋裡也有溫水，違反規定；(C)(D) 是把東西倒進另一鍋，不是隔水加熱。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Big Apple News
Taiwanese Bian-dang in Manhattan, New York City
5/30/2014   by Eva Schmidt

During lunch time, on 53rd Street, you'll see a long line of people in front of a Taiwanese food truck for their "bian-dang," a Taiwanese word for "lunch box." On the menu you can find fried chicken with rice, pork dumplings, tea eggs, and other popular Taiwanese dishes.
The owners of the food truck are Thomas and Diana Yang, two Taiwanese-Americans. This brother-sister team started their business in 2009. Back then, there were a few Taiwanese restaurants in the city and several thousand food trucks, but the Yangs were the first to sell Taiwanese food on a food truck.
At first, business was slack. People thought they were just another Chinese food truck, and the food truck's name, "Cravings," often made people think of desserts, not lunch. Few people would stop by and try their food. "I couldn't even give away free food," said Thomas. To catch people's eye, they painted their truck blue, and drew Taiwan's national flower, the plum blossom, on it. They also changed the food truck's name to "bian-dang." Soon people started to notice them, and business finally got better. Now on a good day, they can sell about 150 bian-dangs in about two hours.
So what's next for Thomas and Diana? Well, they hope one day there will be a block with Taiwanese food in the city, just like there is a Chinatown, a Korea Town, and a Little Italy. And their bian-dang food truck might just help to make that happen.
(national 國家的)

What does the news story say about the Yangs' food truck?

options.A: What people love about their food.
options.B: What made them start their business.
options.C: How they made delicious fried chicken.
options.D: How they fixed their business problems.

questions.explanation: 第三段說一開始生意不好，大家以為是普通中式餐車、店名 Cravings 讓人聯想到甜點；於是他們把車漆成藍色、畫上梅花、改名為 bian-dang，生意才好轉。這段就是在說他們「如何解決生意上的問題」，所以選 (D)。文中沒有說明顧客喜歡什麼、創業動機或炸雞的做法。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
This is a letter by Selena Bieber to the students in her school.
http://www.nvhsstudsup.org/openletter

Later Is Better!
Selena Bieber
Northville High School

Do you feel it's hard to get up early for school and even harder to listen well in the first class at 8 a.m.? Well, this happens to most of us and is not helpful for our learning!
Some studies show that teenagers' brains make melatonin, the hormone that helps sleep, between 11 p.m. and 8 a.m. So it's better for us to sleep during these nine hours. But here comes the problem. We're asked to get to school by 7:30 a.m. That means we have to get up before 7, when our brains should still be sleeping. That's why we're always so tired and can't think clearly in early morning classes. No clear head, no good learning, right?
If we can't change how our body works, why can't school start later? In this way, we can not only sleep more but also learn better!
Want to help us make it happen?
Visit www.nvhsstudsup.org/later-better to learn more.
(brain 大腦 hormone 荷爾蒙)

What problem is Selena Bieber trying to fix?

options.A: High school lessons are too difficult.
options.B: Classes start too early in the morning.
options.C: Too many students are late for school.
options.D: Lunch break is too short for taking a rest.

questions.explanation: 信的標題是 Later Is Better!，內容說學生 7:30 就得到校、7 點前就要起床，但大腦這時還該睡覺，所以早上的課總是很累、無法專心，最後提問 why can't school start later?（為什麼學校不能晚點開始上課？）。她想解決的是「早上上課時間太早」，選 (B)。

We're asked to get to school by 7:30 a.m. That means we have to get up before 7, when our brains should still be sleeping. If we can't change how our body works, why can't school start later? In this way, we can not only sleep more but also learn better!

Below is some information from another study.
We studied 48 high school students and found that the students who went to bed earlier did better on their school tests. This is not only true for those who slept nine hours, but also true for those who slept less. And some of them agreed that they learned better in early morning classes.

Do the ideas in Selena Bieber's letter agree with the information?

options.A: Yes, because her letter says it is better to sleep from 11 p.m. to 8 a.m.
options.B: Yes, because her letter says getting up early is not helpful for learning.
options.C: No, because her letter says students are asked to get to school by 7:30 a.m.
options.D: No, because her letter says teenagers' brains do not work well in early morning classes.

questions.explanation: 另一份研究說有些學生認為自己 learned better in early morning classes（早上的課學得比較好），而且早點睡的學生考得較好，即使睡不到九小時也一樣。Selena 的信卻主張青少年大腦在清晨的課堂中運作不佳，兩者看法相反，答案是 No，理由為 (D)。(C) 雖然也回答 No，但「7:30 到校」只是事實陳述，不是和研究衝突的觀點。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
2013 July

Kivalina, an island village in Alaska, USA, is known by only a few people. It cannot be found on most maps of Alaska because it is only 10 km². This small Arctic village is home to 400 Inuit people*. However, their home will become uninhabitable because the island could be covered by the Chukchi Sea by 2025. These Inuit people will have to leave their home.
But life now is already difficult. Over the past twenty years, winters have become warmer, the Arctic ice has kept melting, and the sea has been rising. These changes have made it harder to live by hunting and fishing than before. What's worse, there is no Arctic ice thick enough to keep them safe from terrible wind and rain.
These Inuit people think it is the oil and power companies in Alaska that have brought all these troubles, but they are the ones who are paying the price. It would cost hundreds of millions to move their village, and they have no idea where to get the money. Groups like ReLocate are working together with the Inuit people to save Kivalina, but nobody is sure if their hard work will come to anything. All the Inuit people can do now is to pray the rising sea will not cover their home too soon.

* The Inuit people are a group of people who live in the Arctic.
(melt 融化  hunt 打獵  company 公司)

What can we learn about Kivalina?

options.C: It is fighting for one last hope.
options.D: It has given up its chance to rise.

questions.explanation: 文中說這座村莊可能在 2025 年被海水淹沒，搬遷需要數億經費卻不知道錢從哪來；雖然有 ReLocate 等團體在協助拯救，但沒人確定會不會成功，居民只能祈禱海水不要太快淹上來。這表示 Kivalina 正在為「最後一線希望」奮鬥，選 (C)。村莊還在，所以不是 (B) 已成歷史；他們也沒有放棄，所以不是 (D)。

What does it mean when we say a place is uninhabitable?
questions.concept_tag: 上下文詞義與指代推測
questions.explanation: uninhabitable 後面接著說因為島可能被海水淹沒，所以 These Inuit people will have to leave their home（他們必須離開家園），可見這個地方將「無法居住」，選 (D)。也可以從字形推測：inhabit 是「居住」，un- 表否定，-able 表「能夠」。

(melt 融化  hunt 打獵  company 公司)

What does the writer think about the Inuit people in Kivalina?

options.A: Their way of living has been hurting the earth.
options.B: They might not be able to get enough money to move their village.
options.C: They should make the oil and power companies fix their problems.
options.D: There are better ways than to move their village to somewhere else.

questions.explanation: 作者寫道搬遷村莊要花數億元，而 they have no idea where to get the money（他們不知道錢從哪裡來），也就是他們可能籌不到足夠的錢搬村，選 (B)。(A) 文中說的是石油和電力公司帶來問題，不是居民傷害地球；(C) 這是居民自己的想法，不是作者主張；(D) 文中沒有提出更好的替代方法。

What does the reading say about the Arctic ice?

options.A: The Arctic ice covered 10 km² of Kivalina.
options.B: The melting Arctic ice kills about 400 Inuit people each year.
options.C: The Arctic ice helped the Inuit people in Kivalina during bad weather.
options.D: The melting Arctic ice has given the Inuit people enough water to use.

questions.explanation: 文中說 there is no Arctic ice thick enough to keep them safe from terrible wind and rain（已經沒有夠厚的冰能保護他們免受暴風雨侵襲），反過來說，以前北極的冰能在惡劣天氣時保護居民，選 (C)。10 km² 是村子的面積；400 是居民人數，不是死亡人數；文中也沒提到融冰提供用水。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
After a lot of tests and interviews, you finally got into a good school or got a good job. But there's a problem: it's a long way from home. "Well, I can take the bus or drive," you might think. But before you decide whether it's OK to have such a long commute, it's best to know __35__.
Having a long commute means you'll get fewer hours of sleep, and that'll make you feel tired easily. You'll also have less time for friends and family, for exercise, or for a nice meal.
A long commute not only eats up your time but also __36__. Studies show that people who have a long commute get fat easily and often have neck or back problems. It's easier for them to have heart problems too. __37__. Studies find that these people get angry more often, feel less happy with their lives, and do less well at work.
Now, does that good school or that good job still sound good to you?
(interview 面試  commute 通勤)

Choose the best answer for blank 35.

options.B: how you can enjoy it more
options.C: how it will change your life
options.D: what is the best way of commute for you

questions.explanation: 空格後的兩段都在說長時間通勤對生活的影響：睡眠變少、陪家人朋友和運動的時間變少、傷害健康、影響情緒與工作表現，最後還問你「那所好學校或好工作聽起來還好嗎？」所以決定前最好先知道長途通勤「會如何改變你的生活」，選 (C)。文章沒有討論其他選擇、如何享受通勤或最佳通勤方式。

questions.question_text:
After a lot of tests and interviews, you finally got into a good school or got a good job. But there's a problem: it's a long way from home. "Well, I can take the bus or drive," you might think. But before you decide whether it's OK to have such a long commute, it's best to know __35__.
Having a long commute means you'll get fewer hours of sleep, and that'll make you feel tired easily. You'll also have less time for friends and family, for exercise, or for a nice meal.
A long commute not only eats up your time but also __36__. Studies show that people who have a long commute get fat easily and often have neck or back problems. It's easier for them to have heart problems too. __37__. Studies find that these people get angry more often, feel less happy with their lives, and do less well at work.
Now, does that good school or that good job still sound good to you?
(interview 面試  commute 通勤)

Choose the best answer for blank 36.
questions.explanation: not only A but also B 表示「不只 A 還有 B」：長途通勤不只吃掉你的時間，還會「傷害健康」。空格後舉的例子是容易發胖、脖子和背部出問題、容易有心臟疾病，都是健康問題，所以選 (B)。花錢、塞車、破壞地球在文中都沒有提到。

questions.question_text:

A long commute not only eats up your time but also __36__. Studies show that people who have a long commute get fat easily and often have neck or back problems. It's easier for them to have heart problems too. __37__. Studies find that these people get angry more often, feel less happy with their lives, and do less well at work.
Now, does that good school or that good job still sound good to you?
(interview 面試  commute 通勤)

Choose the best answer for blank 37.
questions.explanation: 空格前講的是身體上的健康問題，空格後改講情緒與工作表現（更常生氣、對生活較不滿意、工作表現較差），是在補充更多壞處，所以用 But that's not all（不只如此）來承接，選 (B)。(A) 表因果、(C) 表舉例、(D) 說可以被阻止，都接不上後面「再多一項壞處」的內容。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
NOlympics in Munich
11/11/2013

People in the city of Munich have spoken their mind: they do not want to host the Winter Olympics in 2022. To the cities that fight for this chance, __38__. The Olympics usually do a lot of good to the host city. The Games bring in jobs, visitors, and, most important of all, money. So why did people in Munich say no?
The Olympics __39__ for people in Munich. For them, the world's biggest sports festival could invite serious trouble. There would be a lot of building work before the Games, and during the Games, too much traffic and too many visitors. Life would become terrible and nature would be hurt. And __40__: Munich hosted the 1972 Summer Olympics, and its neighbor, the mountain town Garmisch-Partenkirchen, hosted the 1936 Winter Olympics.
Still, the heavy price Munich paid does not worry the cities that are in the race to get the 2022 Winter Olympics. __41__, they are happy that Munich said no to the Olympics—their chances of getting the Games have become higher.
(host 舉辦  Olympics 奧運  visitor 遊客)

Choose the best answer for blank 38.

options.B: this sounds like a good idea
options.C: this is perhaps a smart answer
options.D: this is old news they have heard

questions.explanation: 空格後說奧運通常對主辦城市有很多好處，能帶來工作、遊客和最重要的錢。對那些拚命爭取主辦權的城市來說，慕尼黑竟然拒絕主辦，當然「令人意外」，所以選 (A)，接著作者才問 So why did people in Munich say no?。(B)(C) 表示認同慕尼黑的決定，和這些城市的立場不符；(D) 與「出乎意料」的語氣相反。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
NOlympics in Munich
11/11/2013

People in the city of Munich have spoken their mind: they do not want to host the Winter Olympics in 2022. To the cities that fight for this chance, __38__. The Olympics usually do a lot of good to the host city. The Games bring in jobs, visitors, and, most important of all, money. So why did people in Munich say no?

(host 舉辦  Olympics 奧運  visitor 遊客)

Choose the best answer for blank 39.
questions.explanation: 前一段說奧運對一般主辦城市有好處，這一段卻說對慕尼黑人而言奧運可能帶來嚴重麻煩（施工、交通、遊客過多、破壞自然），所以對他們來說奧運「是另一回事」，are a different story 用來表示情況不同，選 (B)。(C)(D) 都是正面說法，和後文的麻煩相反。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:

11/11/2013

(host 舉辦  Olympics 奧運  visitor 遊客)

Choose the best answer for blank 40.

options.A: this will not go away; it will stay
options.B: they are not just saying it; they are going to do it
options.C: they do not speak for others; they only speak for themselves
options.D: this is not a guess; it is a lesson they learned from hard experience

questions.explanation: 冒號後說明慕尼黑辦過 1972 年夏季奧運、鄰近小鎮辦過 1936 年冬季奧運，表示慕尼黑人擔心的麻煩不是憑空猜測，而是親身經歷過的教訓，選 (D)。其他選項都無法和「曾經主辦過奧運」這項證據連起來。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
NOlympics in Munich
11/11/2013

People in the city of Munich have spoken their mind: they do not want to host the Winter Olympics in 2022. To the cities that fight for this chance, __38__. The Olympics usually do a lot of good to the host city. The Games bring in jobs, visitors, and, most important of all, money. So why did people in Munich say no?
The Olympics __39__ for people in Munich. For them, the world's biggest sports festival could invite serious trouble. And __40__: Munich hosted the 1972 Summer Olympics, and its neighbor, the mountain town Garmisch-Partenkirchen, hosted the 1936 Winter Olympics.

(host 舉辦  Olympics 奧運  visitor 遊客)

Choose the best answer for blank 41.
questions.explanation: 前句說慕尼黑付出的沉重代價並沒有讓其他競爭城市擔心，後句更進一步說他們其實很高興慕尼黑退出，因為自己的機會變大了。後句是對前句更強烈的補充，用 In fact（事實上）最適合，選 (A)。However 表轉折，但前後語意同方向；If so、Finally 也接不上。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: [An illustration shows an old man wearing glasses holding a book, standing across from a boy who is bending forward at the waist toward him.] In the picture, the boy is _____ the old man.
questions.explanation: 圖中男孩彎腰低頭面向老人，這是「鞠躬」的動作，bow to 表示「向……鞠躬」，故選 (D)。男孩沒有笑、沒有跳舞，也不是在加油，所以 smiling at、dancing with、cheering for 都與圖不符。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Listen! The baby _____ in the bedroom. Why don't you go in and take a look?
questions.explanation: 句首 Listen!（你聽！）表示說話當下正在發生的事，要用現在進行式 is crying。後句「你何不進去看看？」也說明寶寶此刻正在哭。(A) 過去式、(B) 現在簡單式（習慣）、(D) 未來式都不符合「正在」的語意。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Jill is _____ that the city park is closed for the music festival because now she can't jog there.
questions.explanation: because 後面說明原因：公園因音樂節關閉，她現在不能去那裡慢跑，所以 Jill 應該是「不開心的」unhappy。excited（興奮）、proud（驕傲）都是正面情緒，與原因矛盾；scared（害怕）也和「不能慢跑」無關。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Steven wants to be a _____, because he loves to watch people enjoy the food he prepares.
questions.explanation: 關鍵線索是 he loves to watch people enjoy the food he prepares（他喜歡看別人享用他準備的食物），準備食物給人吃的職業是 cook（廚師）。注意 cook 當名詞就是「廚師」；farmer 雖然種食物，但不是「準備」餐點給人吃。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Paul misses his parents a lot. He _____ them since he came to work in Taiwan a year ago.
questions.explanation: since + 過去時間點（since he came to work in Taiwan a year ago）表示「從過去某時一直到現在」，要搭配現在完成式 have/has + p.p.，主詞 He 為第三人稱單數，故用 hasn't seen。句意：他自從一年前來台灣工作後就沒再見過父母，所以很想念他們。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Our teacher Ms. Wu seldom laughs, but when she _____, everyone in the same building can hear her.
questions.explanation: 空格是為了避免重複前面的動詞 laughs，用助動詞代替：原句是現在簡單式、主詞 she 是第三人稱單數，所以用 does（= laughs）。can、will 改變了語意，has 則是完成式用的助動詞，都不對應前面的 laughs。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: My sister is coming to my home today. She _____ with me for a week.
questions.explanation: 姊姊「今天要來」（is coming today，表示即將發生），她待一週是從今天之後才開始的事，所以要用未來式 will stay。stayed、has stayed 是已發生的事，stays 則表示習慣，都不合語意。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Edward had worked as a computer engineer for ten years. This _____ helped him a lot when he started his own computer shop.
questions.explanation: 前句說 Edward 當了十年電腦工程師，This 指的就是這段工作「經驗」，所以選 experience。chance（機會）、hobby（嗜好）不符；knowledge（知識）雖然相關，但前句描述的是「做了十年工作」這件事本身，最貼切的是 experience。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: If you're interested in our business plan, _____ this number and ask for Ms. Lee. She'll answer your questions.
questions.explanation: If 子句後面接主要子句，這裡是對聽者下指示，要用祈使句，以原形動詞開頭，所以選 call。句意：如果你對我們的計畫有興趣，打這支電話找李小姐。(C) and call 多了 and，前面並沒有可以對等連接的動詞，所以不對。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Jimmy would not get up for breakfast, _____ his dad had already tried to pull him from his bed several times.
questions.explanation: 前句「Jimmy 就是不起床吃早餐」，後句「爸爸已經試著把他從床上拉起來好幾次」，兩句是語意上的相反轉折，要用 although（雖然）。because 會變成「因為爸爸拉他所以他不起床」，不合邏輯。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Duncan spent all his money trying to _____ the bookstore his mom left him. Sadly, the business never got better, and he had to close it in the end.
questions.explanation: 書店是媽媽留給他的（the bookstore his mom left him），已經存在，所以不需要 build、buy 或 start。後句說生意始終沒有好轉、最後只好關店，可知他花光錢是想「挽救」書店，故選 save。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Fiona loves listening to her children sing songs _____ at school.
questions.explanation: 空格是修飾 songs 的形容詞子句，完整應是 songs (that) they learned at school，關係代名詞 that 當 learned 的受詞，可以省略，所以選 they learned。(B) that learned 會變成「歌自己學」；(A)、(D) 用被動 are learned，主被動關係錯誤（是孩子學歌）。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Beverly eats lots of snacks _____ meals. That's why she is often too full to eat anything at mealtimes.
questions.explanation: 後句說她到了用餐時間常常太飽吃不下，可知她是在「兩餐之間」吃很多零食，between meals 是固定用法。during meals（用餐時）或 after meals（飯後）都無法解釋為什麼吃飯時已經太飽。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Nora: Can I check your drawer for some tools we can use?
Matt: Sure. Take a look. See if you can find _____ in there.
questions.explanation: Nora 要找「一些工具」，Matt 請她看看抽屜裡能不能找到「任何（工具）」。在 if（是否）引導的句子中常用 any 代替 some，any 在這裡當代名詞，指 any tools。it 是單數特定物，those、others 則沒有明確的指涉對象。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following ad.

"We're online now!"
We've prepared many wonderful surprises for you at e-BeautiMed, BeautiMed's online store!
Surprise 1: Join "BeautiMed Friend" online for free and get 2000 BeautiMed points!
Surprise 2: Already a "BeautiMed Friend"? Come collect your free gift by entering your "BeautiMed Friend" card number at e-BeautiMed before 8/31.
Surprise 3: Get 500 BeautiMed points by shopping at e-BeautiMed and you'll get 500 more points if you spend more than $1,000.
Surprise 4: Shop at e-BeautiMed during 7/1-8/31 and you may win $5,000 or free movie tickets!
Surprise 5: Invite a friend to join "BeautiMed Friend" and you both can get 1000 points each!

What is this ad for?

options.A: Teaching people how to use their BeautiMed points.
options.B: Telling people they can shop at BeautiMed on the Internet now.
options.C: Inviting people to share their shopping experience at e-BeautiMed.
options.D: Letting people know what is on sale at e-BeautiMed from 7/1 to 8/31.

questions.explanation: 廣告標題是 We're online now!（我們上線了！），開頭又說 e-BeautiMed 是 BeautiMed 的「線上商店」，五個驚喜都是為了宣傳新開的網路商店，所以主旨是告訴大家現在可以在網路上購物，選 (B)。廣告沒有教人怎麼用點數，也沒有列出特價商品，(A)、(D) 都只抓到細節。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following dialogue.

Joey: Lynn, have you tried Caldron? I've heard that restaurant is good.
Lynn: I have. I went there once for Tom's party.
Joey: And?
Lynn: Well, I never thought I would have to cook for myself when eating out.
Joey: But it's fun to cook your own food.
Lynn: I don't see any fun in that. Besides, I want nice food.
Joey: So you didn't like the food there?
Lynn: Everything tasted the same. I mean, they were all cooked in the same boiling pot. How could they taste different? I just kept throwing strange things into the pot. I didn't even know what half the things were made of.
Joey: Don't worry. Everything should be safe to eat after a hot bath in the pot. And you didn't get sick after that, right? Besides, you tried something different there. Still a good experience, I think?
Lynn: I don't think we share the same idea of good experiences.

Lynn took some photos at Tom's party. Which is most likely one of them? (Options are four illustrations: (A) a family barbecuing meat and fish outdoors on a grill; (B) a family sitting at a table eating hot pot/shabu-shabu with steam rising, a chef nearby; (C) a family at a table with pizza and a chef bringing more pizza from a brick oven; (D) a formal dinner party at a table with covered dish plates and chandeliers.)
questions.explanation: Lynn 說在 Caldron 吃飯得自己煮，所有東西都丟進同一鍋滾水裡煮（cooked in the same boiling pot），Joey 也提到食物在鍋裡「泡熱水澡」，可知這是一家火鍋店。圖 (B) 大家圍著冒煙的鍋子自己夾料煮食，最符合。(A) 是戶外烤肉、(C) 是披薩、(D) 是正式西餐，都不是一鍋煮。

What can we learn about Lynn from the dialogue?

options.B: She likes to try new food.

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Below is a page from Katie's diary.

Dear Diary, June 7, 2011
I was very sad to hear what happened to Woollie yesterday. Woollie was my favorite sheep. I have a storybook about Woollie. It says when Woollie was four, he ran away from Mr. Armstrong's farm, and it took Mr. Armstrong six years to find Woollie. But Woollie had grown so much fleece that he didn't even look like a sheep. Mr. Armstrong decided to cut his fleece on TV so everyone could see. Daddy said this happened on the day I was born. Woollie's fleece weighed 27 kg, and could make clothes for 20 large men. I asked Daddy if his favorite vest was made from Woollie's fleece. Daddy said no, because Woollie's fleece was sold to collect money for sick kids. In the storybook, Woollie was taken to see Ms. Stella Clark, the leader of our city then. They even had tea together. Daddy said Woollie did meet Ms. Clark, but he wasn't sure if they had tea. Daddy said Woollie was put down because he was too sick and there was no way to help him. I cried. I hope Woollie will be happy up there in the sky.

What do we know about Woollie from Katie's diary?

options.B: Woollie was taken to visit sick kids.
options.C: Woollie was sick when he ran away.
options.D: Woollie looked strange without his fleece.

questions.explanation: Woollie 四歲時逃走，過了六年才被找到，所以剪毛那天他已經約十歲；而 Daddy 說剪毛那天正是 Katie 出生的日子，因此 Woollie 比 Katie 年長，選 (A)。羊毛是賣掉幫生病的孩子募款，不是帶羊去探望病童，(B) 錯；日記沒說他逃走時生病，(C) 錯。

What happened when Woollie was put down?
questions.concept_tag: 上下文詞義與指代推測
questions.explanation: 從上下文推測片語意思：Woollie 因為病得太重、沒有辦法救他，所以被 put down；Katie 接著哭了，還希望 Woollie 在天上快樂。可知 put down 在這裡指動物被「安樂死」，也就是他死了，選 (C)。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Here's The Piano Lesson, one of Henri Matisse's most famous paintings. The boy in the picture is the painter's son, Pierre. In the picture, Pierre looks quite serious. Why? Well, look at the yellow candle on the red piano. It's almost burned down. So maybe Pierre has already practiced for hours. And Matisse uses a lot of gray, not a very fun color, right? It shows how the poor kid feels, don't you think?
On the top right corner, you can see a woman sitting straight on a seat. Is she Pierre's piano teacher? Or his mother? Well, if you're a Matisse fan, you'll know this is in fact another painting by him, Woman on a High Stool. Interesting, right? Matisse likes to do that a lot. In fact, there's another work by Matisse in the picture. Did you find it? Right! The sculpture on the bottom left corner!
Matisse painted this picture in 1916. Pierre was already 16 then, but the artist painted his son much younger than he really was. Pierre had gone away to be a soldier, and Matisse didn't know whether he would come back. Maybe this is a worried father's way to remember the good old days.

What can we learn about The Piano Lesson from the reading?

options.A: Matisse painted it when his son was away from home.
options.B: The woman who sits on a seat behind the boy is his mother.
options.C: Matisse uses yellow and red to show that his son was happy.
options.D: The candle on the piano shows that the piano lesson has just begun.

questions.explanation: 最後一段說這幅畫畫於 1916 年，當時 Pierre 已經去當兵、Matisse 不知道他會不會回來，所以是在兒子不在家時畫的，選 (A)。右上角的女人其實是另一幅畫 Woman on a High Stool，不能確定是媽媽，(B) 錯；文中說灰色表現孩子的心情，(C) 錯；蠟燭快燒完表示已練了好幾小時，(D) 錯。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
On Teachers' Day, we thank our teachers for their hard work. We also celebrate this day to remember Confucius, the great Chinese teacher from 2,500 years ago. Well, that's everything we're taught about Teachers' Day. But, the first Teachers' Day was not on Confucius's birthday, and it was not about thanking our teachers.
In 1930, Mr. Tai Shuang-qiu and other teachers celebrated the first Teachers' Day in Nanjing. But there was nothing to celebrate. Teachers were paid very little and not respected. These teachers took this chance to shout out their problems. They had Teachers' Day on June 6 because the date was easy to remember and near the end of the school year. This action by Mr. Tai and the other teachers was welcomed and followed by teachers from other cities. In 1939, the government made Teachers' Day a national holiday. However, it was on August 27, the day when Confucius's birthday was celebrated. Not everyone hailed this decision: Teachers' Day was never about Confucius, and Confucius couldn't speak for all the teachers either.
One funny thing was that the government was wrong about the date of Confucius's birthday. In 1952, people found out he was in fact born on September 28. That was when we started to celebrate Teachers' Day on Confucius's real birthday.

What idea is talked about in the reading?

options.A: How Teachers' Day is celebrated now.
options.B: Why Teachers' Day was celebrated at first.
options.C: Why Confucius was seen as a great teacher.
options.D: How teachers today feel about Teachers' Day.

questions.explanation: 文章第一段就點出「第一個教師節不在孔子生日，也不是為了感謝老師」，第二段接著說明 1930 年老師們發起教師節，是為了藉機說出待遇低、不受尊重的問題。所以全文談的是教師節最初為什麼被慶祝，選 (B)。(A) 只在開頭一句帶過，(C)、(D) 文中都沒有討論。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following notice.

NFR
Dear Traveler,
You have bought an NFR ticket online for a train that runs between White Water City and Cloud City.
We are sorry to tell you that, because of the typhoon last month, the Sand Town – Spring Town line will be closed between August 14 and 28 2016. During this time, some trains will change lines and will not stop at a few stations. There will be free buses to take travelers to these stations. Please check below for the changes. Visit http://www.nfr.gov/ for more information.
We wish you a nice summer.
Lena Muller, National Formosa Railway

1. Trains that run between Green City and Cloud City will take the Smoke Town – Spring Town line, and will stop at every station. Below are the trains that will change lines.
Table (New Line, from 8/14 to 8/28):
Going South: RL101: White Water City → Cloud City; RL102: White Water City → Spring Town; RL103: Green City → Cloud City.
Going North: RL201: Spring Town → Green City; RL202: Cloud City → Green City.

2. The free buses for the Sand Town – Spring Town line will wait at Green City (going south) and Spring Town (going north) stations. No stop at Gray Village.

Route map (a line diagram from north to south): White Water City → Green City → the line then splits into two parallel branches that both lead to Cloud City: (west branch) Green City → Sand Town → Gray Village → Black Town → Cloud City; (east branch) Green City → Smoke Town → Hill Town → Spring Town → Cloud City.

Why does National Formosa Railway write this letter?

options.A: There is a train ticket sale.
options.B: A train line will be closed in July.
options.C: It will open a new train line in August.
options.D: Some of its trains will run on different lines.

questions.explanation: 信中說因為颱風，Sand Town – Spring Town 線在 8 月 14 日到 28 日關閉，這段期間「部分列車會改走其他路線」，下方也列出改線的車次，所以寫信目的是通知部分列車改道，選 (D)。封閉時間是 8 月不是 7 月（颱風才是 7 月），(B) 錯；沒有開新路線，(C) 錯。
questions.text_issue: 路線圖文字描述有誤：原圖西側支線是 Green City → Sand Town → Gray Village → Black Town，接到 Spring Town 後才與東線合併再到 Cloud City（這正是「Sand Town – Spring Town 線」的由來），JSON 卻寫成西線直接通到 Cloud City。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following notice.

NFR
Dear Traveler,
You have bought an NFR ticket online for a train that runs between White Water City and Cloud City.
We are sorry to tell you that, because of the typhoon last month, the Sand Town – Spring Town line will be closed between August 14 and 28 2016. During this time, some trains will change lines and will not stop at a few stations. There will be free buses to take travelers to these stations. Please check below for the changes. Visit http://www.nfr.gov/ for more information.
We wish you a nice summer.
Lena Muller, National Formosa Railway

1. Trains that run between Green City and Cloud City will take the Smoke Town – Spring Town line, and will stop at every station. Below are the trains that will change lines.
Table (New Line, from 8/14 to 8/28):
Going South: RL101: White Water City → Cloud City; RL102: White Water City → Spring Town; RL103: Green City → Cloud City.
Going North: RL201: Spring Town → Green City; RL202: Cloud City → Green City.

2. The free buses for the Sand Town – Spring Town line will wait at Green City (going south) and Spring Town (going north) stations. No stop at Gray Village.

Route map (a line diagram from north to south): White Water City → Green City → the line then splits into two parallel branches that both lead to Cloud City: (west branch) Green City → Sand Town → Gray Village → Black Town → Cloud City; (east branch) Green City → Smoke Town → Hill Town → Spring Town → Cloud City.

What is true about NFR's trains between August 14 and 28 2016?

options.A: No trains will stop at Spring Town.
options.B: Trains that change lines will all stop at Cloud City.
options.C: People can take the free buses to any station on the Sand Town - Spring Town line.
options.D: People can go to Hill Town on any train that runs between Green City and Cloud City.

questions.explanation: 通知第 1 點說 Green City 和 Cloud City 之間的列車都改走 Smoke Town – Spring Town 線，而且「每站都停」，Hill Town 就在這條線上，所以 (D) 正確。RL102 終點是 Spring Town，不是每班改線列車都到 Cloud City，(B) 錯；免費公車不停 Gray Village，(C) 錯；RL102、RL201 都會停 Spring Town，(A) 錯。
questions.text_issue: 路線圖文字描述有誤：原圖西側支線 Sand Town → Gray Village → Black Town 是接到 Spring Town，不是直接通到 Cloud City。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Darayya's Library
John Edwards, July 21 2016

In Darayya, a city in Syria, there's a library, and it has 15,000 books on almost every subject you can think of. However, it is different from any libraries you know: It is a secret underground library, and only people in Darayya know where it is.
Over the years, war has shaken Darayya badly. Every day, houses are bombed and people are killed. Stores are closed one after another, and so are schools. To help the kids in Darayya with their learning, Anas Ahmad, a 19-year-old student, and his friends decided to build a library. They built the library under the ground to keep it safe from bombing. But it is dangerous to collect books for the library. Often, Ahmad and his friends look for books in houses that were bombed. They need to be careful because they may be killed in another bombing.
You may ask, "In a place like Darayya, would people be interested in books?" "Just like the body needs food, the mind needs books," says one library user. In the library, people enjoy their time of reading and forget about the terrible world above, so their life doesn't seem so hard. Through reading, they are able to dream of a better life after war.

Below are the ideas that are talked about in the reading.
a. The problems Darayya has.
b. How Darayya's library was started.
c. What makes Darayya's library special.
d. How Darayya's library helps people there.
In what order does the writer put his ideas in the reading?
questions.explanation: 第一段先說這座圖書館的特別之處：是祕密的地下圖書館 (c)；第二段先描述戰爭帶給 Darayya 的問題（房屋被炸、商店學校關閉）(a)，再說 Ahmad 和朋友如何建立圖書館 (b)；第三段講圖書館如何幫助當地人，讓他們忘卻苦難、夢想未來 (d)。順序為 c→a→b→d，選 (D)。

questions.question_text:
Darayya's Library

In Darayya, a city in Syria, there's a library, and it has 15,000 books on almost every subject you can think of. However, it is different from any libraries you know: It is a secret underground library, and only people in Darayya know where it is.

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following email.

From: Mia Loren <mloren@qmail.com>
To: Dave Doddo <dd1225@qmail.com>
Date: Tue, Oct 24, 2017 at 10:01 AM
Subject: Daniel's 5th Birthday Party – This Saturday!

Hello Dave,
We're happy to invite you and your family to Daniel's fifth birthday party this Saturday.
We know we told you that the party would be in __35__. However, we just moved to Carlton City last month, so the party won't be in Pattersons Town. It'll be at Mosman Garden right next to Victor Zoo, just across from our new apartment. Please don't go to Northbank Park next to our old house.
The weather report said that it may be rainy this weekend, but __36__. If it rains, we'll move the party inside our home. However, if we're __37__ and it is fine, we'll still have the party at the garden.
Again, we're all very happy and excited to welcome you to join us for some fun this weekend!
Best,
Mia, Sam & Daniel

Choose the best answer for blank 35.
questions.explanation: 空格說的是「我們之前告訴你派對辦在哪裡」，後面接 However 說明改變：他們搬家了，派對改到新家對面的 Mosman Garden，並提醒「別去舊家旁邊的 Northbank Park」。可見原本說的地點是 Northbank Park，選 (D)。Mosman Garden 和 Victor Zoo 是新地點附近，Carlton City 是新家所在城市。

questions.explanation: but 後面接的句子要跟「可能下雨」形成轉折，而下一句立刻說明「如果下雨就把派對移到家裡」，這正是備案，所以選 (A)「如果真的下雨，我們有應變計畫」。(B)、(C)、(D) 都和下一句具體的雨天安排接不上。

questions.explanation: 氣象預報說可能下雨，如果結果天氣晴朗（it is fine），就代表他們「運氣好」，所以用 lucky，句意為「如果我們夠幸運、天氣很好，派對仍在花園舉行」。crazy、good、strong 都無法表達「沒遇上雨」的意思。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following story.

Usually I wouldn't cross the park at this time of night. But walking around the park would take more time, and it was raining so hard that I couldn't even see clearly what was right before me. So I entered the park. And that was the first stupid thing I did tonight.
Soon after I walked into the park, I saw a man under a tree up ahead. My heart fell. The stories I'd heard about the park __38__ into my head at this moment. Anyone with a clear mind would just turn back. But me? No. I did __39__ stupid thing: I decided to hurry past him.
Just when I was passing the man, he raised his head and gave me the strangest smile ever. I got scared and started running. "Hey!" the man shouted from behind. "Wait!" He was running after me!
I ran like crazy. I had hoped the trees would keep some rain off. And they __40__. But they also made the park look even darker. I couldn't see what was ahead of me. Then, I ran into something. It was the man!
"Don't kill me!" I cried.
"What? I __41__ to give back your bag! You dropped it," the man gave me my bag.
Now, I felt saying that to the man was the stupidest thing I did tonight.

Choose the best answer for blank 38.
questions.explanation: 整篇故事用過去式敘述，at this moment 指的是故事中看到那個男人的「那一刻」，當時關於公園的各種傳聞正一一湧上心頭，要用過去進行式 were all coming。(A)、(B) 是現在時態，與過去的敘事不合；(D) would 表示推測或過去習慣，不合語意。

questions.question_text:
Read the following story.

Choose the best answer for blank 39.
questions.explanation: 第一段已說進入公園是今晚做的「第一件蠢事」，這裡決定快步經過那個男人，是「又一件」蠢事，所以用 another。the last 不對，因為文末還有「最蠢的事」；the other 用在只有兩者時指另一個，one 則沒有「再一件」的意思。

questions.explanation: 前一句「我原本希望樹能擋掉一些雨」（the trees would keep some rain off），空格用助動詞代替前面的動作，表示「樹的確擋掉了一些雨」，敘事是過去式，所以用 did（= kept some rain off）。後句的 But 再轉折說樹也讓公園更暗。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Read the following story.

Usually I wouldn't cross the park at this time of night. But walking around the park would take more time, and it was raining so hard that I couldn't even see clearly what was right before me. So I entered the park. And that was the first stupid thing I did tonight.

I ran like crazy. I had hoped the trees would keep some rain off. And they __40__. But they also made the park look even darker. I couldn't see what was ahead of me. Then, I ran into something. It was the man!

"What? I __41__ to give back your bag! You dropped it," the man gave me my bag.
Now, I felt saying that to the man was the stupidest thing I did tonight.

Choose the best answer for blank 41.
questions.explanation: 男人解釋他剛才追過來「是一直想把包包還給你」，指的是過去那段時間正在進行的動作，要用過去進行式 was trying。try 是現在式，will try、would try 表示未來或推測，都不符合「剛才一路追著跑」的情境。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Look at the picture. The woman is putting _____ on the cake. (Picture: A woman is decorating a cake with a fork, and there are strawberries and candles on top of the cake on a table with a plate and fork.)
questions.explanation: 圖中女子兩手都拿著蠟燭，正要插到蛋糕上，所以答案是 candles（蠟燭）。桌上雖然有盤子和叉子、蛋糕上也有草莓，但她「正在放上蛋糕」的是蠟燭，要看清楚人物手上的動作。
questions.text_issue: question_text 的圖片描述寫「用叉子裝飾蛋糕」，原圖中女子手上拿的其實是蠟燭（叉子放在桌上盤子旁），描述可能誤導學生選 forks。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: The movie starts at two o'clock, _____ let's meet at the theater at one forty-five.
questions.explanation: 前句「電影兩點開始」是原因，後句「我們一點四十五分在戲院碰面」是結果，表示「所以」要用 so。because 後面應接原因，放在這裡因果顛倒；or、if 語意都不通。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Peter is afraid of the dark. He even leaves the _____ on when sleeping.
questions.explanation: Peter 怕黑，所以睡覺時會把燈開著，leave the lights on 就是「讓燈一直開著」。電腦、電風扇、音樂都和「怕黑」沒有關係。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Pam is a _____ baseball player; she has more fans than any other player on her team.
questions.explanation: 後半句說她的粉絲比隊上任何球員都多，可見她很受歡迎，popular 是「受歡迎的」。boring（無聊的）、heavy（重的）、rich（有錢的）都無法從「粉絲多」推出。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: I did not do my homework, so my teacher said I _____ stay after school to finish it.
questions.explanation: 因為沒寫作業，老師說我「必須」留下來寫完，had to 表示「不得不、必須」（have to 的過去式）。used to 是「過去習慣」、hoped to 是「希望」、failed to 是「沒能」，都不符合老師要求的語氣。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Kevin has only enough money for the bag or the shoes. That is a hard _____ to make because he likes them both.
questions.explanation: Kevin 的錢只夠買包包或鞋子其中一樣，而且兩樣都喜歡，所以很難選擇。make a choice 是固定搭配「做選擇」，a hard choice 就是「艱難的抉擇」。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: It was _____ for us to answer the math question because we've done the same kind of questions many times.
questions.explanation: 因為同一類題目已經做過很多次，所以回答這題數學題很「容易」，選 easy。句型 It is + 形容詞 + for 人 + to V；common（常見的）、special（特別的）與「做過很多次所以會」的因果不合。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Although it took me lots of time _____ a big meal for ten people, I was happy that everyone enjoyed it.
questions.explanation: 固定句型「It takes + 人 + 時間 + to V」表示「某人花多少時間做某事」，所以要用不定詞 to prepare。preparing、prepared、原形 prepare 都不符合這個句型。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Don't let the children swim in the river. We don't know how _____ it is. It could be dangerous.
questions.explanation: 不讓孩子在河裡游泳，是因為不知道河水有多「深」，how deep 問深度。far 問距離、long 問長度、thick 問厚度，都和游泳的危險無關。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Bob is _____ of the boys in the family. He never does any housework. His brothers at least take out the garbage sometimes.
questions.explanation: 空格後有 of the boys in the family（家中所有男孩當中），是三者以上的比較，要用最高級 the laziest。後文也說他從不做家事、兄弟們至少還會倒垃圾，可見他是最懶的。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Aunt Gina has lived in this town for more than sixty years, so she _____ it very well.
questions.explanation: 她在這個鎮上住了六十多年（現在完成式，到現在仍住著），所以「現在」很了解這個鎮，用現在簡單式 knows 表示現在的狀態。knew 是過去，will know 是未來，都不合語意。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: We won't see the sun even after the typhoon leaves, because the news said that heavier rain will soon _____.
questions.explanation: 颱風離開後仍看不到太陽，因為新聞說更大的雨很快就會「接著來」，follow 是「隨後而來」。若選 stop（停止）就和「看不到太陽」互相矛盾。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Yesterday when I got home from work, my brother _____ for dinner, so he invited me to join him.
questions.explanation: 「我昨天回到家時」哥哥「正要出去吃晚餐」，所以才邀我一起去；過去某時間點正在進行或即將進行的動作用過去進行式 was going out。went out 會變成他已經出門了，就不可能邀我同行。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: You were _____ not to lend Amy money. She never gives back what she borrows.
questions.explanation: Amy 借東西從來不還，所以你不借她錢是「明智的」，wise 符合。句型 You were + 形容詞 + not to V 表示「你沒做某事是……的」；crazy、wrong 是負面評價，與後句的理由相反。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Have you found a summer job yet? Mr. Firth _____ someone to take care of his kids during the vacation. Maybe you can talk to him.
questions.explanation: Firth 先生「目前正在找」暑假照顧小孩的人，所以才建議你去跟他談，用現在進行式 is looking for。was looking for 是過去，可能已經找到了，就不必建議你去談。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: David looked out of the balcony window and saw a woman get in his car _____ away.
questions.concept_tag: 分詞構句與感官使役動詞
questions.explanation: 感官動詞 see + 受詞 + 原形動詞：saw a woman get in his car and drive away，get 和 drive 是對等的兩個動作，用 and 連接且都要用原形。drove 會和前面的原形 get 形式不一致，所以不選 and drove。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: The police haven't found the little girl who _____ at a supermarket. They'll keep doing all they can to find her.
questions.explanation: 小女孩是「被帶走」的，要用被動語態，且事情發生在過去（在超市時），所以用 was taken away。took away 是主動，意思變成她帶走別人；taken away 缺少 be 動詞。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Buses to the airport only come once every hour, and we just missed _____. Why don't we take a taxi?
questions.explanation: 我們剛錯過的是「一班」公車，不特定的單數可數名詞用 one 代替（one = a bus）。it 指特定那一個，前面說的是 buses 泛指，不適合；them 指全部公車也不對；another 是「另一個」。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text: Ariel _____ every night for a week before her Chinese test and got a very good grade.
questions.explanation: 考前讀了一週書並拿到好成績，都是過去發生的事，後面 got 也是過去式，所以用過去式 studied。has studied 是現在完成式，不能與過去已結束的事件搭配。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
While reading this story, Brad saw the word "trolling" and didn't know what it meant.

Josh turned off the screen and sat back. "Why are they trolling me like this?" He didn't understand. They wanted him to share what he thought about the show, and he did. And now look what he got. In the end, all they wanted was nice words.

He found several meanings of the word in a dictionary. Which one should Brad choose?

options.B: To make someone or something move around.
options.C: To pull a fishing line through the water, often from a boat.
options.D: To write something on the Internet to hurt someone or make them angry.

questions.concept_tag: 上下文詞義與指代推測
questions.explanation: Josh 關掉螢幕，他在網路上分享對節目的看法後，別人卻回應讓他難過，而對方只想聽好話，可見 trolling 是指「在網路上寫東西讓人受傷或生氣」。其他選項如唱歌慶祝、拉釣魚線都跟這段情境無關。

options.D: Another picture of the tea cup.

questions.explanation: 傳單規定明信片上要寫姓名、生日、電話、e-mail 和最喜歡的茶。Jason 已寫了姓名、電話、e-mail 和最愛的紅茶，也貼了兩張茶杯圖，唯獨少了生日。傳單沒有要求寫年齡或自己的地址，茶杯圖也只要兩張，所以不選 A、B、D。
questions.text_issue: question_text 在明信片描述中加了「傳單上有 address 方框、但 Jason 沒寫自己的地址」這種說明，原圖的 address 方框只是生字註解（address 地址），這段描述會誤導學生選 (B)。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Below is an infographic titled "Dangerously Sweet: Sugar."

How much sugar can we have a day? Man: 9 teaspoons of sugar. Woman: 6 teaspoons of sugar. Child: 3 teaspoons of sugar. (1 teaspoon = 4 g of sugar)

How much sugar do we have a day? The UK: 17.1 teaspoons for each person. Taiwan: 17.75 teaspoons for each person. The US: 18.75 teaspoons for each person.

Sugar that is hidden in foods and drinks (shown as spoon icons next to each item): ice cream (66 g), cheesecake (95 g), orange juice (300 ml), rice milk (400 ml), cola (330 ml), sports drink (590 ml), grape juice (400 ml) — the number of spoon icons increases roughly in that order, with grape juice and sports drink shown with the most spoons (sugar).

What does sugar do to our body? remembering less well; looking older than our age; holes in our teeth; heart problems; liver problems; stomach problems; spending longer time in the bathroom; feeling worried or unhappy easily; getting fat; sleeping less well.

What can we learn about sugar from the infographic?

options.A: There are 4 g of sugar in 66 g of ice cream.
options.B: A woman can eat as much sugar a day as a man can.
options.C: Taiwan eats more sugar for each person than the US does.
options.D: 400 ml of rice milk has less sugar than 400 ml of grape juice.

questions.explanation: 圖表中 400 ml 米漿（rice milk）的湯匙比 400 ml 葡萄汁（grape juice）少，所以含糖較少，D 正確。A 錯：66 g 冰淇淋有 4 匙糖，約 16 g，4 g 只是一匙；B 錯：女性每天 6 匙、男性 9 匙；C 錯：台灣每人 17.75 匙，比美國 18.75 匙少。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Below is an infographic titled "Dangerously Sweet: Sugar" (see details: daily sugar limits for man/woman/child, average daily sugar intake in the UK/Taiwan/US, a list of "Sugar that is hidden in foods and drinks" showing sugar amounts in ice cream, cheesecake, orange juice, rice milk, cola, sports drink, and grape juice using spoon icons, and a diagram of "What does sugar do to our body" listing effects like remembering less well, looking older, holes in teeth, heart/liver/stomach problems, spending longer time in the bathroom, feeling worried or unhappy easily, getting fat, and sleeping less well).

What can be a reason why the list of "Sugar that is hidden in foods and drinks" is put in the infographic?

options.A: To help us understand how sugar hurts our body.
options.B: To show what kinds of foods and drinks are popular with children.
options.C: To tell us that we often have more sugar than we can without knowing it.
options.D: To let us know how much sugar is enough to make foods and drinks taste good.

questions.explanation: 「藏在食物和飲料裡的糖」這一欄列出冰淇淋、果汁、可樂等常見食品的含糖量，很多都超過一天建議的量（例如女性 6 匙），目的是提醒我們常在不知不覺中吃進過多的糖，選 C。說明糖怎麼傷身的是左下「What does sugar do to our body?」那一區，不是這份清單，所以不選 A。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Darrell: Marina…Marina…MARINA!
Marina: Oh, sorry. I didn't hear you. I was thinking about my homework.
Darrell: What's it about?
Marina: Well, I need to draw a future house for my art class, but I haven't got any ideas. Maybe I should go to the library and look for something useful.
Darrell: Or you can try Pinterest.
Marina: Isn't it a shopping app?
Darrell: Not really. Many people share their works on Pinterest and tell you how they made them. I'm sure you can get some ideas there.
Marina: Sounds like you use it often.
Darrell: Yeah. Just last week I went there and found the A to Z of making chocolate cake—from choosing good chocolate to baking the cake to making sugar flowers on top.
Marina: Really? I'll check it out later. Thanks a lot.

Why did Darrell tell Marina to go to Pinterest?

options.A: To find some examples for her homework.
options.B: To shop for things that are needed for art classes.
options.C: To meet new friends who have the same interests.
options.D: To share her works and tell people how they are made.

questions.explanation: Marina 要為美術課畫「未來的房子」卻沒有靈感，Darrell 說很多人在 Pinterest 分享作品和做法，她可以在那裡得到點子，也就是去找作業的參考範例，選 A。Darrell 特別說 Pinterest 不是購物 app，所以 B 錯；分享作品是別人在做的事，不是叫 Marina 去分享，所以 D 錯。

questions.explanation: Darrell 說找到做巧克力蛋糕的 A to Z，後面接著解釋「從挑選巧克力、烤蛋糕到做上面的糖花」，也就是從頭到尾、每個步驟都有。所以 learn something from A to Z 指「學到關於它的全部」，選 C。

questions.subject: english_read
questions.question_text:
Tabata training is a very popular way of exercising these days. It doesn't take much time or space, and it burns calories faster than other ways of exercising. The idea of Tabata training is simple: exercise for 20 seconds, rest for 10 seconds, and then repeat (at least eight times). The moves for the 20-second exercise are not difficult to learn. Jumping jacks, high knees, squats, and planks are some of the most common moves. You can decide yourself what moves to do in your Tabata training. For example, you can do more leg exercises if you want strong legs.

(Pictures show four exercise moves in two steps each: JUMPING JACK, HIGH KNEES, SQUAT, PLANK.)

One great thing about Tabata training is that your body will keep burning calories for at least an hour after 4 minutes of Tabata training. But to have this wonderful "afterburn," you need to exercise really hard during each 20 seconds. If you seldom exercise or have heart problems, this exercise may not be good for you. But for people who enjoy exercising but are too busy to go to the gym, Tabata training might just be the answer.

Which idea is talked about in the first paragraph of the reading?

options.A: How you should do Tabata training.
options.B: What is the best time for Tabata training.
options.C: Who first had the idea of Tabata training.
options.D: How often you should do Tabata training.

questions.explanation: 第一段說明 Tabata 的做法：運動 20 秒、休息 10 秒、至少重複八次，並介紹常見動作、可自己決定做哪些動作，都是在講「怎麼做 Tabata 訓練」，選 A。文中沒提最佳時段、發明者，也沒說一週該做幾次。
